jobs.title: Hiring Now! Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Arellano Associates (AA) is a professional community outreach firm specializing in the transportation, clean energy, and water sectors. We bridge the gap between government agencies and the public by combining meaningful, digital and in\-person engagement with innovative technology to deliver a transparent and accessible communication process for our client's projects.  

  

By creating engagement opportunities for stakeholders to have a genuine voice in the planning and decision\-making process, we build trust, encourage collaboration, and help reduce disparities; working together toward a more connected, sustainable, and equitable California.  

  

The Assistant Project Coordinator (APC) is a full\-time, entry\-level role on the front lines of that work, supporting public outreach and stakeholder engagement for a project team under the guidance of a Project Manager. The position calls for learning agility, the ability to pick up new tools, including AI, quickly and apply them well. It also calls for ownership and follow\-through, the discipline to get the details right on a public meeting, a mailer, or a project update, since those are the details that ultimately make an impact on the communities we serve. This position is also a launchpad into a career in public outreach and project delivery, with plenty of room to grow within the company.  

  

Check out some of the Projects we are working on and how we are making an impact to communities all throughout Southern California!: https://www.arellanoassociates.com/projects  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Content Creation:** Draft written text for collateral materials including fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, posters, e\-communications, and social media content.
* **Messaging Support:** Help tailor draft content to project goals and different audiences, building an understanding of how messaging shifts depending on the community and client you're working with.
* **Event Coordination:** Support in\-person public engagement events such as public meetings, pop\-ups, and special events, including logistics, supplies, and staffing.
* **Public Interaction:** Engage directly with community members at outreach events, facilitate participation, and help gather public feedback that shapes project strategy.
* **Tech Tools \& AI:** Apply the latest tech tools, including AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude, to communicate project information and gather public input, using platforms like ArcGIS, SurveyMonkey, MetroQuest, Poll Everywhere, Typeform, Google Forms, Constant Contact, Salesforce, SharePoint, and WordPress.
* **Creative Production:** Use Adobe Creative Suite programs, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere Pro, for basic file creation and editing.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Coordinate vendor services including printing, catering, translation and interpretation, and toll\-free phone lines.
* **Database \& Website Management:** Keep stakeholder databases, project websites, and social media content current and accurate.
* **Digital Engagement:** Monitor public input coming through email, project websites, helplines, and online engagement tools, and flag issues or notable responses to your project manager promptly.
* **Task Tracking:** Organize and maintain project documentation, support scheduling, and help the team track progress and coordinate resources.
* **Project Support:** Complete tasks within timeframes and budget parameters, helping ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery.
* **Issue Communication:** Communicate issues and challenges to your project manager promptly.

  

### **What We Look For:**

 **In Every Team Member*** **Learning Agility:** You take feedback well and treat the unfamiliar as something to figure out rather than avoid. This industry and role will be new to most people who take it on, so you're the kind of person who asks a clarifying question instead of guessing. You are comfortable asking questions, jumping into something new, and curious about new technologies.
* **Ownership and Follow\-Through:** You follow through on what you say you will do, whether that's a deadline on a fact sheet or a task from a morning check\-in. When something's off, whether it's a typo you caught or a vendor that fell through, you speak up early instead of hoping it resolves itself, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* **Collaboration and Mentoring:** You work well with others and know a project runs better when everyone's pulling in the same direction. You help teammates succeed, whether that's covering an event when someone's out or walking a newer team member through a process you've already learned. Ultimately, you make the people around you better at their jobs.
* **Curiosity with Technology and AI:** You're comfortable picking up new software and tools, including AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude, and applying them to real tasks. Whether that's drafting a first pass at a newsletter or researching a project topic, you know good AI use means checking the work, not just accepting it.
* **Professionalism:** You represent yourself, AA, and our clients well in every interaction. From a public meeting to an internal email. You ask questions rather than guess, show up on time and prepared, and handle mistakes with maturity.

**For This Role*** **Public Interaction:** You're comfortable talking with members of the public, whether that's staffing a table at a community event, answering questions at a public meeting, or fielding a call from a concerned resident. You can translate technical project details into plain language, and you stay professional even when someone's frustrated. No professional outreach experience required, we'll help you build it.
* **Writing and Content:** You can put together a clear, accurate first draft, whether it's a fact sheet, a newsletter article, a social media post, or a project update. You take direction well on tone,

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Vintage Crossings)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.
  
  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/
  
  

The opportunity
  
  

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
  
Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
  
Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
  
Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident\-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
  
Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
  
Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
  
Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
  
Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
  
Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
  
Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door\-to\-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high\-traffic locations.
  
Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
  
Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
  
Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
  
Collect \& submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
  
Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.
  
  

What you'll bring
  
  

Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Farsi preferred
  
Two years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
  
  

**Experience in both:**  

after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
  
serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness.
  
Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
  
Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
  
Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
  
The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.
  
Credentials/Certifications
  
Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
  
CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
  
Successful completion of background check and LiveScan
  
  

**The details:**  

This is a part\-time (29 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position
  
**Schedule:** Mon/Weds/Fri 12:30pm\-5:30pm, Tues/Thurs 10am\-5:30pm; Ability to work an occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule is subject to change.
  
**Location:** Vintage Crossings Apartments, 700 East South St, Unit 100, Anaheim, CA 92805
  
**Wage:** $25hr
  
  

**Benefits offered:**  

Term life insurance and an Employee Assistance Program
  
Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
  
Pro\-rated paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays
  
  

Project Access, Inc. is an at\-will and equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace. We value diversity in all its forms and actively seek to build a team that reflects the richness of our community. Our hiring practices are designed to identify and welcome talented individuals regardless of their race, ethnicity, cultural background, religious beliefs or practices, gender identity or expression, relationship status, age, neurotype, physical or sensory abilities, sexual orientation, military service history, or any other aspect of their identity protected by law. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, more innovative solutions, and a stronger community impact. Our goal is to foster an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills.

* Build and maintain relationships with community partners, landlords, and stakeholders.

* Represent the organization at community meetings, events, and conferences.

* Track and report program outcomes and performance metrics.
* Utilize data to evaluate program effectiveness and inform improvements.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Knowledge of local housing resources and services.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail

**Attributes**

* Compassionate and empathetic.
* Proactive and self\-motivated.
* Commitment to the mission of providing housing solutions to those in need.

jobs.title: Junior Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Hyperkin is a gaming hardware and accessories company specializing in retro and modern gaming products. We are known for products such as the RetroN series and officially licensed gaming controllers, while continuing to develop new and innovative products for today's gaming market.

We are looking for a **Junior Marketing Coordinator** who is creative, organized, interested in gaming, and ready to learn. This is a hands\-on position where you will work directly with our marketing, design, sales, and product teams to help bring new products to market.

Responsibilities

* Assist with day\-to\-day marketing activities and product launches
* Help create and schedule content for **Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other social platforms**
* Write basic social media captions, product descriptions, and promotional copy
* Coordinate product photos, videos, samples, and marketing assets
* Assist with influencer and content creator outreach
* Research gaming trends, competitors, and new marketing opportunities
* Help monitor social media performance and prepare simple reports
* Assist with email marketing and website promotions
* Support trade shows, gaming events, product launches, and promotional campaigns
* Work with the graphic design team to coordinate marketing materials
* Communicate with Sales and R\&D teams to understand new products and key selling points
* Help maintain the marketing calendar and ensure projects stay on schedule
* Perform other marketing\-related duties as needed

Qualifications

* 0–2 years of marketing, social media, or related experience
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field preferred
* Recent graduates are encouraged to apply
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable using Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and social media trends
* Organized and able to manage multiple projects
* Creative mindset with attention to detail
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Shopify, Klaviyo, or similar tools is a plus
* Interest in **video games, gaming hardware, retro gaming, or consumer electronics is strongly preferred**

Who We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who already knows everything about marketing. We are looking for someone who is **motivated, responsible, creative, and willing to learn**.

The right candidate should enjoy social media and gaming culture, be comfortable sharing new ideas, and be willing to take ownership of projects as they gain experience.

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants to **build a career in gaming and consumer\-product marketing** and gain hands\-on experience with real product launches.

What You'll Gain

* Hands\-on experience launching gaming products
* Experience working with licensed and original gaming products
* Exposure to social media, influencer marketing, e\-commerce, PR, and retail marketing
* Opportunity to work closely with product development, design, and sales teams
* Room to grow into a larger marketing role as the company expands

How to Apply

Please submit your **resume** along with a short introduction explaining:

* Why you are interested in marketing
* Why you would like to work in the gaming industry
* Your favorite gaming brand, product, or social media campaign and why

**Portfolio, social media work, school projects, or personal content are welcome but not required.**

**Hyperkin Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

POVISON is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC), final\-mile, and white\-glove delivery performance.

Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is **REQUIRED** for this position due to regular communication and coordination with POVISON's China\-based team.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China\-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end\-to\-end post\-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at\-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final\-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final\-mile and white\-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable\-to\-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics\-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China\-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English – REQUIRED
* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E\-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e\-commerce, or final\-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross\-border e\-commerce or Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white\-glove final\-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator I
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly motivated Research Coordinator I to support clinical trials and observational research in Alzheimer's disease, related dementias, and neurodegenerative disorders.


Working directly under the supervision of Dr. Lon Schneider, Professor of Psychiatry, Neurology, and Gerontology, the Research Coordinator I will support the day\-to\-day coordination of study activities, including participant recruitment, regulatory documentation, and data management. The successful candidate will be able to work independently on assigned responsibilities, maintain high\-quality study documentation, support ongoing monitoring, and audit readiness, and contribute to improved regulatory and operational processes across the research program.

**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Coordinate assessments, tests, and other assigned clinical trial activities to meet research objectives and study protocol compliance.
* Support participant recruitment, screening, eligibility tracking, orientation, scheduling, and correspondence.
* Collect, record, manage, and analyze data for research studies. Prepare and submit accurate, complete, and timely reports according to project schedules or on an ad hoc basis.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, including submissions, amendments, and informed consent, in compliance with FDA, GCP, IRB, HIPAA, SOPs, sponsor and institutional policies.
* Prepare sites for sponsor monitor visits and internal reviews, quality assurance checks, and audit\-readiness activities.
* Organize project\-related meetings and events to increase knowledge about clinical trials and regulations. Provide ongoing guidance to research personnel and study participants to maintain compliance.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (in life sciences, health sciences, pharmacy, psychology, neuroscience, public health, regulatory science, clinical research, or a related field) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum one\-year of administrative or research experience.
* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree, or two or more years of relevant experience
* Experience in Alzheimer's disease, dementia, neurodegenerative disease, neurology, psychiatry, geriatrics, or CNS clinical trials.
* Experience coordinating research activities, including clinical trials and human subjects research
* Knowledge of medical environment and terminology
* Familiarity with USC systems and workflows, including OnCore, IRB submissions, REDCap, SharePoint, sponsor portals, and other Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

**Work Location**


This position is full\-time on\-site and employee must report to work at the USC Health Science Campus in Los Angeles, CA when scheduled. Work hours and on\-site days may be subject to change depending on business needs.


The hourly rate range for this position is $32\.45 \- $42\.48\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 1 year Minimum Field of Expertise: Administrative or research experience. Working knowledge of MS Office applications. Demonstrated effective communication and writing skills. Ability to multi\-task and prioritize. Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team as well as independently.

jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator - Long Beach
jobs.description:
Healthy Brain Clinic in Long Beach, CA is part of the Irvine Clinical Research site network, the largest of its kind on the West Coast. With 5 research centers in California, we are leaders in the search for new treatments in neurology, psychiatry, and obesity medicine. Our largest area of research is in Alzheimer’s Disease prevention and treatment drug trials, and our doctors were the largest contributors in the world to the most recently FDA\-approved medication in Alzheimer’s Disease.

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced **Clinical Research Coordinator** to drive trial success at our Long Beach location. This role is ideal for a seasoned CRC (internally leveled as a CRC II, III, or IV depending on experience) who is ready to take ownership of complex Phase II and III clinical trials. You will work closely with our Principal Investigators and clinical team to ensure the highest standards of data integrity, patient safety, and operational excellence.
### **Job Duties**

* **Study Management:** Serve as the primary or co\-coordinator for assigned Phase II/III clinical research studies, overseeing day\-to\-day operations from site initiation to closeout.
* **Protocol Compliance:** Execute study procedures with strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, FDA regulations, and specific study protocols.
* **Patient Coordination:** Guide participants through complex visit schedules, including consenting, screening, and coordinating cross\-functional appointments (e.g., imaging, infusions).
* **Data Integrity:** Timely and accurately enter, organize, and maintain study data across various electronic platforms (eSource, EDC, CTMS), proactively resolving queries.
* **Clinical Assessments:** Conduct vital signs, ECGs, and other protocol\-specific diagnostic, efficacy, and safety assessments.
* **Quality \& Audit Readiness:** Maintain impeccable regulatory and source documentation, ensuring the site is consistently prepared for sponsor monitoring visits and audits.

### **Job Requirements**

* **Experience:** 2 to 4\+ years of hands\-on experience coordinating industry\-sponsored clinical trials (prior experience in CNS, Neurology, or Psychiatry is a strong plus).
* **Technical Skills:** Demonstrated ability to navigate complex clinical trial management systems (CRIO eSource \& CTMS) and EDC platforms quickly and accurately.
* **Organization \& Precision:** Exceptional attention to detail, capable of managing competing priorities and complex visit windows without compromising quality.
* **Communication:** A strong, professional command of spoken and written English, with a proven ability to build rapport with older adult populations and their study partners.

**Hours and Compensation**
* **Location:** This is a full\-time employment position based in\-person at our Healthy Brain Clinic / Long Beach site in Long Beach: 1703 Termino Ave, Ste 201, Long Beach, CA 90804
* **Compensation:** The expected salary range for this position is **$30\-40 per hour** (**$62,400 to $83,200 per year**). *Final compensation offers will be determined based on the candidate's specific internal level (CRC II \- IV), years of relevant clinical trial experience, and applicable clinical certifications (e.g., CCRC, nursing, or phlebotomy license).*
* **Insurance:** The company covers 100% of employee\-only premiums for our baseline Gold HMO health plan, plus dental and vision coverage.
* **Paid Time Off:** Vacation (PTO) is earned at a rate of **3 weeks per year**.
**Equal Opportunity \& Fair Chance Employer** *Healthy Brain Clinic and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.description:

The Client Experience Concierge \& Marketing Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for clients, guests, advisors, and visitors while providing administrative, operational, and marketing support to the office. This position is responsible for creating a welcoming, professional, and exceptional client experience at the Client Experience Center while also supporting the office’s marketing initiatives, communications, and business development activities.

The ideal candidate is a **highly motivated, organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented self\-starter** who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. This individual must possess a strong sense of urgency, excellent follow\-through, and the ability to effectively balance front\-desk responsibilities with marketing projects and administrative priorities.

**While this position includes significant marketing and project coordination responsibilities, the Client Experience Center remains the primary responsibility of the role, and the successful candidate must be comfortable balancing front\-desk coverage and client\-facing responsibilities with marketing and administrative projects.**

* Responsible for maintaining all office supply and Client Experience Center inventory

* Coordinate event logistics, invitations, materials, communications, and follow\-up
* Assist with presentations, social media, newsletters, and other marketing materials

* Coordinate with advisors, staff, and vendors to support successful project execution
* Support special projects and initiatives as assigned
* Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism
* Other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet \& Rooter Services** is seeking a **Key Account Manager** to join our team! The Key Account Manager (KAM) will be responsible for protecting, strengthening, and growing LA Hydro\-Jet's (LAH) most important customer relationships.

  

**What Sets L.A. Hydro\-Jet Apart:**


* **Competitive Pay:** **$80,000\-$100,000 \+****, plus incentive program**
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan \+ match
* **Time Off:** Vacation and paid holidays

**Position Summary**

This person will serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of key accounts, developing strong connections with decision\-makers, understanding each customer's business and service needs, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand LAH's share of their business across multiple service lines. The KAM will accomplish this through regular customer contact, account planning, quarterly or semiannual business reviews, site visits, relationship\-building activities, and close coordination with LAH's operations, sales, estimating, and service teams to ensure the customer receives consistent value and strong support. Success will be measured primarily by year\-over\-year revenue growth within assigned accounts, customer retention, increased penetration of LAH services, and the strength of the overall customer relationship. The KAM will be expected to understand where each account stands financially, identify why an account is growing or declining, maintain a pipeline of expansion opportunities, and take action when business is at risk. Ultimately, the role is successful when key customers view LA Hydro\-Jet as a trusted partner and increasingly choose LAH as their primary—or preferred—service provider.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO\-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**
* 3\-5\+ years of B2B account management, strategic customer success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing a book of business, large customer relationships, or multi\-location accounts.
* Track record of retaining and growing existing customer revenue.
* Strong consultative selling, cross\-selling, negotiation, and opportunity\-development skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to customer leadership.
* Ability to analyze account revenue, service mix, trends, and opportunities using CRM and basic reporting tools.
* Strong organizational skills with disciplined follow\-up and calendar management.
* Valid driver's license, a clean MVR, and ability to travel locally throughout LA Hydro\-Jet's service territory.
* Availability for occasional early\-morning, evening, weekend, customer, or industry events as business needs require.
**What Sets You Apart:**
* Experience in property management, facilities, commercial services, plumbing, HVAC, restoration, waste, construction, or another B2B field\-service industry.
* Experience with property\-management companies, facility teams, restaurants/hospitality groups, multifamily operators, or other multi\-site customers.
* Experience conducting quarterly business reviews (QBRs), account\-planning meetings, or executive customer presentations.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable CRM/field\-service platform.
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required in place of strong relevant experience.

### **Role Expectations \& Work Environment**


* This position is expected to spend meaningful time with customers and in the field rather than working exclusively from a desk.
* The role may involve customer\-site visits, office meetings, business meals, industry events, and approved entertainment activities.
* The employee must maintain professional judgment regarding gifts, entertainment, confidentiality, customer policies, and conflicts of interest.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
* Act as the primary relationship owner when an assigned customer has a complaint, service failure, or escalation.
* Coordinate with Operations and department leadership to understand root cause, corrective action, and customer communication.
* Stay engaged until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved appropriately.
* Escalate material retention risks or competitive threats promptly to leadership.

### **Required Job Traits**



**Trait**

  

**Why It Matters**

  

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**

  


**Relationship Builder**

  


Creates trust and loyalty with customers.

  


Develops genuine relationships at multiple levels of the account.

  


**Proactive / Self\-Starter**

  


The role cannot depend on inbound calls.

  


Creates reasons to contact customers and advances opportunities without being prompted.

  


**Commercial Mindset**

  


Customer satisfaction alone is not enough.

  


Comfortably asks for additional work and seeks a larger share of customer spend.

  


**Ownership Mentality**

  


Major accounts require clear accountability.

  


Treats account performance as personal responsibility and acts quickly when revenue or satisfaction declines.

  


**Emotional Intelligence**

  


Strategic accounts involve different personalities and pressures.

  


Reads the room, adapts communication, and handles difficult conversations professionally.

  


**Curiosity / Consultative Thinking**

  


Growth comes from understanding customer operations.

  


Asks strong questions about properties, budgets, pain points, vendor structure, and future plans.

  


**Organization / Follow\-Through**

  


Large portfolios create many commitments and touchpoints.

  


Maintains disciplined follow\-up, CRM hygiene, review cadence, and next steps.

  


**Resilience / Persistence**

  


Sales and relationship\-building include rejection and delay.

  


Follows up appropriately withou

* Catch the reactions when collectors receive their items, and the moments with athletes and partners

**Build formats, not just posts**

* When something works, turn it into a repeatable format, template, or franchise rather than treating every post as a one\-off
* Develop recurring series that give The Realest a recognizable rhythm and identity

**Experiment, measure, and lean in**

* Try a lot, watch what performs, understand why, and double down on what's working
* Stay extremely aware of internet culture, formats, and what's landing — but translate it through an elevated The Realest lens. We should feel current and fast without chasing every meme or trend
* Track views, saves, shares, and follower growth, and turn the numbers into your next move

**Run creator and influencer engagement (secondary)**

* Identify and work with creators, influencers, and brand ambassadors who fit our mission \- a meaningful part of the role, but always secondary to creating great content ourselves

 **Requirements** **Who You Are**

* A maker first — you see the post before you pick up the phone, and you'd rather ship than sit on an idea
* Fast and autonomous: you spot the story and run with it without waiting for a brief
* Fluent in internet culture and where attention is going, with the taste to filter it through an elevated brand lens
* Equal parts creative and analytical — you love a good hook and a good data point
* Someone who genuinely gets why memorabilia matters to the people who collect it

 **What We're Looking For**


Honestly, we care much more about taste, instincts, and great work than about checking traditional experience boxes. We're not counting years.

* **A strong portfolio of short\-form content you've personally shot and edited — this is what matters most**
* Hands\-on craft across filming and editing, with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or whatever gets you there (phone\-first is fine — we care about the eye, not the gear)
* Fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook \- the tools, the culture, and how each platform's algorithm actually works
* An instinct for formats and franchises \- you recognize a repeatable idea when you see one
* Comfort with analytics (native platform insights, Google Analytics, and similar) and the instinct to act on what they tell you
* **Based in or around Los Angeles and able to be on\-site, with flexibility to travel for key events**
* A genuine interest in sports, music, or movie memorabilia \- you should get why this stuff matters

jobs.description:
**Work Location**

**Why CHOC?**

At CHOC, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at CHOC can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. CHOC’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. Apply now to see where your career at CHOC can take you.


**Environmental Sustainability Statement**

Driven by the connection between children's health and a healthy environment, we commit to creating a healthcare model that incorporates environmental sustainability aligned with our mission to protect children's health and patient safety.


**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator Supervisor (CRC\-Su) functions independently and is responsible for the complete coordination of multiple assigned human subjects’ (clinical) research projects and is expected to perform all core Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) responsibilities. The Supervisor serves as a mentor, an educator, and a leader with first\-line supervisory oversight (e.g., involved with hiring, reviewing, and terminating other associates). Study management includes but is not limited to assessing feasibility of clinical research protocols, preparing materials needed for regulatory review and submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), identifying potential study participants, coordinating and collecting research data/specimens, completing study records in an accurate and timely manner, participating in quality assurance audits, managing study materials and supplies, communicating across multiple teams, and archiving records in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures. The Supervisor will be responsible for financial components of clinical research projects, documentation of investigator product (drug or device), development of source documents and/or case report forms and running research/project team meetings. In this role, the Supervisor may support investigator\-initiated Investigational New Drug (IND) or Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) applications, monitor or audit studies in the Research Institute, educate and mentor clinical staff, research team members, and other coordinators, and may be requested to coordinate multi\-center studies. The Supervisor is responsible for evaluating CRC performance and assists the Site Manager in resolving operations workload, protocol implementation, and data collection issues. The Supervisor may also participate in one or more workgroups or committees within the Research Institute with a focus on CRC operations. The Supervisor is the most senior position in the Clinical Research Coordinator series.
**Pay Range**

Minimum $90,563 Midpoint $120,016 Maximum $149,427
*Rate of pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, education, as well as position requirements.*

**Experience**

Required: Minimum six (6\) years of clinical research coordination experience.


Preferred: Clinical research experience in a hospital setting and/or pediatric clinical research experience and demonstrated leadership experience.  



  

**Education**

Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent additional experience can be accepted in lieu of education.


Preferred: Master’s degree in a relevant field.


**Specialized Skills**

Required: Working knowledge of key Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills. Able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Be detail oriented. Able to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple competing priorities. Working knowledge of human subjects’ regulatory requirements and International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use Guidelines for Good Clinical Practice (ICH\-GCP). Ability to conduct informed consent. Strong knowledge of research sample identification, processing, and storage. Ability to manage conflict and to create a culture of accountability within their assigned team. Demonstrate good time and priority management and is capable of problem\-solving.


Preferred: Working knowledge of Cerner or equivalent electronic medical record system.  



  

**Licensure**

Required: Basic Life Support (BLS) \- American Heart Association. If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 6 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 6 months due to extenuating circumstances. Association of Clinical Research Professionals Certified Professional (ACRP\-CP), Certified Clinical Research Professional (CCRP) or Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) \- If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 12 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 12 months due to extenuating circumstances.


Preferred: Phlebotomy certification.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a driven and relationship\-focused Sales \& Account Manager to join our team. This is a multi\-dimensional role that blends new business development, consultative selling, customer success, and ongoing account management \- all within the self\-storage and RV parks and campgrounds industries. Our core products are data\-driven market intelligence tools that provide operators, investors, and industry professionals with market\-centric analysis and actionable insights. Additional offerings include APIs, custom data reports, and a real estate listings platform. The ideal candidate brings direct knowledge of the self\-storage sector and can speak credibly to the needs and language of operators, investors, and brokers.


Success in this role requires someone who can open doors, communicate the value of data\-driven decision\-making, nurture long\-term relationships, and ensure customers are supported well beyond the initial sale.


Job Responsibilities:
**Sales \& Business Development*** Prospect, qualify, and close new business across target customer segments within the self\-storage and RV parks and campgrounds industries
* Sell data products, market intelligence subscriptions, API access, and custom data reports tailored to the needs of operators, investors, and industry professionals
* Develop and execute outreach strategies to grow the customer base across the full product suite, including listings platform advertising for brokers
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets
* Present solutions effectively to a range of stakeholders \- from owner\-operators and management companies to institutional buyers, brokers, and data\-driven investors

**Customer Success \& Relationship Management*** Guide customers through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and well\-supported experience from contract signing through activation
* Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle, providing a high level of service and responsiveness
* Proactively check in with clients post\-sale to assess satisfaction, identify upsell opportunities, and resolve any issues
* Educate customers on product features, data interpretation, and best practices for leveraging market intelligence to maximize the value of their subscription or engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor, offering consultative support rooted in an understanding of the self\-storage and RV parks and campgrounds markets

**Account Management*** Manage and grow an assigned book of accounts, maintaining strong retention and renewal rates
* Track account health, engagement, and performance metrics; develop action plans for at\-risk accounts
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships through additional products, services, or platform features
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all customer interactions and pipeline activity in CRM
* Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, product, support) to advocate for customer needs and provide feedback

**Industry Events \& Trade Shows*** Represent the brand and product offerings at self\-storage industry conferences and trade shows, typically 2\-3 major national events per year
* Attend regional and local industry events as needed to build relationships, generate leads, and stay current on market trends
* Engage prospects and existing accounts at events through booth presence, networking, and presentations, converting event interactions into pipeline opportunities
* Provide post\-event follow\-up and reporting to ensure leads and commitments are captured and acted upon in a timely manner


Candidate Profile:
**Required*** Demonstrated experience in a sales role \- ideally combining new business development with account management
* Meaningful knowledge of or direct experience within the self\-storage industry (operations, investment, brokerage, or related services); familiarity with RV parks and campgrounds is a plus
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to build trust and credibility with a variety of stakeholders
* Comfort operating in a consultative sales environment with longer relationship cycles
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and general sales tools

**Preferred*** Prior experience selling data products, SaaS platforms, market intelligence tools, or digital media \- particularly in a real estate or commercial property context
* Established relationships with self\-storage brokers, operators, or investors
* Familiarity with APIs and how data integrations work; a general understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) layers and automated workflows is a plus
* Experience selling to or working alongside commercial real estate professionals, and familiarity with how brokers and buyers use listing platforms
* Willingness and ability to travel for industry events; estimated 2\-3 national conferences per year plus occasional regional events

**What Success Looks Like*** Revenue targets are met with a healthy mix of new business and account expansion across the full product suite
* Customers feel well\-supported throughout their journey \- from first contact through renewal \- and refer others as a result
* Accounts are retained at a high rate due to strong service, engagement, and demonstrated product value
* Internal teams benefit from clear customer feedback and insights surfaced through close account relationships
* New brokers and advertisers are consistently brought onto the listings platform through proactive outreach and relationship\-building


Compensation, Benefits and Work Authorization:

In addition to the posted base salary range, this position is eligible for commission and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed **here****.** Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
  
Let’s Get Loco!

The Field Marketing Specialist leads the execution of El Pollo Loco’s local store marketing (LSM) programs, new restaurant opening (NRO) initiatives, and community engagement activities. This role owns key field marketing programs end\-to\-end including strategy, execution, and continuous improvement and provides critical leadership to ensure field marketing plans are delivered effectively and consistently across corporate and franchise restaurants. Local Store Marketing Support
  
* Execute local store marketing campaigns, promotions, public relations initiatives, and programs that drive sales, traffic, and brand awareness.
* Coordinate with restaurant leadership to distribute marketing toolkits, materials, and resources.
* Maintain, update, and review assets and requests in the Local Store Marketing Portal, ensuring guides and materials are accurate and accessible.
* Track usage and engagement with LSM tools to identify opportunities for improvement.

* Draft and manage email correspondence across franchisee, vendor, and internal audiences, ensuring communications are timely, accurate, and on\-brand.


Analytics \& Reporting
  
* Support the collection, organization, and reporting of field marketing data, campaign performance, and local insights.
* Assist in analyzing promotional outcomes and identifying opportunities to improve future activations.


Other Duties
  
* Provide general marketing support as assigned by the Field Marketing Manager.
* Participate in local market visits and assist onsite for key events, when needed.

jobs.description:
Job description

We are looking for a creative and motivated Social Media Marketing Specialist to join our team and help grow our brand across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other social media platforms.

The ideal candidate understands social media trends, short\-form video, content creation, and audience engagement. You will help develop and execute our social media strategy while creating engaging content that showcases our brand, services, and expertise.

Responsibilities

* Develop and execute social media content strategies for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms
* Create engaging Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, Stories, and posts
* Develop creative content ideas that increase engagement, reach, and brand awareness
* Stay current with social media trends, popular sounds, hashtags, and emerging content formats
* Assist with filming, editing, and organizing short\-form and long\-form video content
* Write engaging captions, titles, and descriptions
* Maintain a consistent social media content and posting schedule
* Monitor social media analytics and recommend ways to improve performance
* Research competitors and identify new content and marketing opportunities
* Collaborate with our team to create content featuring our services, treatments, and promotions

Qualifications

* Experience managing or creating content for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
* Strong understanding of social media marketing and current trends
* Experience creating short\-form video content; YouTube Shorts experience is a plus
* Creative mindset with a strong eye for visual content
* Familiarity with CapCut, Canva, Adobe, or similar editing tools
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Marketing, communications, social media, or related experience preferred

Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Beauty & Wellness Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Business Development Representative – Beauty \& Wellness Partnerships

Location: Orange County, CA

Job Type: Full\-Time / Part\-Time

Compensation: Base Pay \+ Competitive Commission

About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, outgoing, and results\-driven Business Development Representative to help expand our local partnership network throughout Orange County.

The primary focus of this position is to develop relationships with local hair salons, nail salons, beauty salons, massage studios, spas, wellness businesses, and other beauty\-related businesses and create mutually beneficial referral and promotional partnerships.

This is a field\-based business development and sales position. The ideal candidate is comfortable visiting local businesses, introducing our services in person, building relationships with owners and managers, and turning those relationships into ongoing referral opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and visit potential beauty and wellness business partners throughout Orange County
* Build relationships with hair salons, nail salons, beauty salons, massage studios, spas, and other local businesses
* Introduce our medical aesthetics and wellness services to potential partners
* Develop referral and cross\-promotional partnerships
* Distribute approved marketing materials and explain current promotions
* Follow up consistently with business owners and managers
* Maintain and grow existing partnership accounts
* Generate qualified referrals and new client opportunities
* Track outreach activities, leads, partnerships, and referral results
* Represent our company professionally at local businesses, networking events, and community events
* Work closely with management to develop new local marketing and partnership opportunities

Qualifications

* Previous experience in sales, business development, outside sales, beauty, aesthetics, wellness, hospitality, or local marketing is preferred
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable approaching and speaking with business owners and managers
* Self\-motivated and goal\-oriented
* Strong relationship\-building and follow\-up skills
* Familiarity with Orange County communities and local businesses is a plus
* Existing relationships within the beauty, salon, spa, or wellness industry are highly preferred
* Must be comfortable with local travel throughout Orange County
* Bilingual English/Chinese, English/Spanish, or English/Korean is a plus

Compensation

We offer base pay plus a competitive commission structure, with strong earning potential based on performance.

The more qualified partnerships and business opportunities you develop, the greater your earning potential.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Costa Mesa, CA 92627

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.


Job Description:


We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate new business opportunities through proactive outreach and prospect engagement. In this role, you will identify potential clients, build early relationships with key decision\-makers, and create qualified opportunities for the Account Executive team.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, goal\-oriented environment and is interested in building a successful career in sales.

**Responsibilities**

* Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
* Research target accounts and identify the right contacts to engage.
* Qualify prospects by understanding their business needs, priorities, and level of interest.
* Schedule meetings for Account Executives and support the development of a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain accurate activity and lead records in CRM and sales tools.
* Follow up consistently to keep prospects engaged and move conversations forward.
* Partner with sales and marketing teams to improve outreach efforts and support pipeline growth.
* Stay informed on market trends and competitor activity to strengthen prospecting conversations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 1 or more years of experience in outbound prospecting/sales, business development, lead generation, or another customer\-facing role.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence engaging with prospective clients and initiating conversations.
* High\-resilience, adaptability, and a positive attitude in a performance\-driven environment.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Comfort using CRM systems and sales tools.
* Self\-motivated, coachable, and eager to grow in a sales career.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B sales, SaaS, HR technology, or business services is preferred.
* Experience with outbound prospecting and lead qualification practices is helpful.
* Experience using tools such as Salesforce, Gong Engage, 6sense, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar platforms is a plus.

**Performance Metrics**

* Success in this role will be measured by outbound activity, meetings booked, qualified opportunities created, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and the accuracy of CRM updates.

**Career Path**


This role offers a strong foundation for growth into Account Executive, Sales Leadership, or other revenue\-focused roles based on performance and development.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $56,800 to $71,000 \+ commission (role has a 60/40 pay mix). Pay will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and relevant education and training. This position is eligible to participate in a commission plan. The Company also offers a full range of benefits, including medical, dental, and 401k. Your recruiter can share more details about the specific compensation package during the hiring process.

**The Accurate Way:**


We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

  



**Take ownership.**


Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.  



**Be open.**


Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

 **Stay curious.**


Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

 **Work as one.**


Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

 **Equal opportunities**


Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatric CHAMP Program
jobs.description:
The overall goal of the position is to support the developing research enterprises of the Child Health Advanced Molecular Phenotyping (CHAMP) Program, which is designed to help investigators better understand childhood disease by making high\-quality human biological samples and molecular data more accessible across UCSF.


Many serious pediatric illnesses remain difficult to explain using traditional clinical information alone. CHAMP addresses this gap by supporting the careful collection, processing, preservation, and study of biological samples from children across a wide range of diseases and clinical settings. The goal is to make it easier for researchers to connect what is happening in a child's body at the molecular and cellular level with the clinical course of illness.


CHAMP is built around two complementary goals. The first is to create a coordinated infrastructure for collecting biofluids and tissues from willing participants, especially children with severe, rare, or poorly understood diseases. Whenever possible, samples are obtained from the sites most relevant to disease and are processed using protocols designed to preserve their value for both current and future technologies.


The second goal is to pair these samples with advanced molecular profiling platforms that can generate detailed information about immune responses, gene expression, cellular states, antibodies, pathogens, and other features of disease biology. These data can then be used by investigators across UCSF to generate new hypotheses, identify disease mechanisms, and ultimately improve diagnosis and treatment for children.


CHAMP operates under IRB\-approved protocols that allow collection of human biofluids and tissues, including biopsy and post\-mortem specimens, across organ systems and age groups. The program has developed workflows for rapid processing, cryopreservation, and live cell preservation so that valuable samples can be studied with the best available technologies.


The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of two concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills ; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members and outside institutions
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects
Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator – Melanoma and Cutaneous Oncology Program
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Cutaneous Oncology clinical research team supports a diverse portfolio of studies for melanoma and non\-melanoma skin cancers, including squamous cell, basal cell, and Merkel cell carcinomas. The team partners with specialists across Dermatology, Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology, and Radiation Oncology to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care. Our focus includes outpatient, therapeutic cancer clinical trials in phases I–III, including both industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated studies. We also manage noninterventional studies aimed at improving early detection, risk assessment, and long\-term survivorship.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will independently, or with general direction, execute, manage, and coordinate clinical research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager, Principal Investigator (PI), and/or the Associate Director of Clinical Research Programs for the Early Phase program. The CRC will coordinate the administrative, data, and patient scheduling operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols and regulatory policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to, supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies; managing and updating databases to ensure data integrity; acting as intermediary between sponsors, research staff, and various UCSF departments; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies;; maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; reporting study progress to investigators; participating in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and performing other duties as assigned.  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.

If you are passionate about delivering top\-tier customer service, managing HR data with accuracy, and creating a seamless candidate journey, this position offers an inspiring opportunity to grow your HR career!

**Context:** At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.  


**Scope:** Under direct supervision from the Director, Membership Operations, the Membership Operations Coordinator will be responsible for preparing all donations received in the Oakland office for processing and depositing. This is an on\-site position that requires opening and sorting incoming mail in the Oakland office, entering the donor information into the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database (currently Salesforce), and working with the Sierra Club Finance Department to ensure the donations are deposited. The position is vital to help speed up the process and deposit major gift donations.

### **Job activities include but are not limited to:**

* Opens and sorts incoming mail and prepares for depositing checks by the caging vendor or by the Sierra Club’s Finance Department. Researches incoming check donations in the CRM (Salesforce) database and codes them for processing.


* Images and scans donations to our external vendor for processing. Tracks and edits gifts in the Salesforce database to complete processing.


* Completes data entry of donations for the Sierra Club Foundation. Researches and codes incoming donations for Sierra Club Foundation staff to process in a timely manner. Then enters the donations into the CRM and batches the checks for the Sierra Club Foundation to deposit.


* Works with the caging vendor to identify processing issues and adjust/resolve procedurally.


* Works with the Sierra Club Foundation and the Sierra Club Finance Department to answer any questions on balancing month end reports.


* Works with Chapter staff and volunteers on processing their donations.


* Tracks and sends back checks that are unable to be processed.


* Performs miscellaneous data entry tasks that include but are not limited to: coding returned mail, fulfilling personal mail requests, processing check donations entered by the Sierra Club Finance Department, and processing credit card donations mailed to the Oakland office.


* Researches and prepares special projects and reports, using various word processing and spreadsheet applications. Reports on regular performance indicators to management, by monitoring reports of external vendors and flagging key indicators.


* Serves as a contact person for Chapters to process c3 donations. Handles incoming checks, ensuring that they are uploaded to the external caging vendor or given to Foundation staff if the check requires special handling. Answers questions from the Chapter, Foundation, or the Chapter Funding department if there are issues with c3 checks being deposited.
### **The successful candidate must have the following skills and experience:**

* Experience in fundraising with expertise in caging, cashiering, and CRM databases.
* Demonstrated ability and effectiveness in organizational, planning, project management, problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work with others to help ensure necessary progress on projects and maintain awareness of impacts and project status across multiple areas.
* Demonstrated ability analyzing and integrating processes, systems and information; using databases and/or informational resources to deliver program services; developing and monitoring budgets for complex programs or products; demonstrated knowledge of cost\-benefit and other financial/program analyses
* Committed to evolution. You are committed to continuously deepening and evolving your own understanding of systems of oppression through study, openness, and humility. And you easily recognize your own relationship to privilege and power, examining and shifting your behaviors as appropriate.
* Uplifting and additive. You see mistakes as opportunities for growth; problems as catalysts for solutions, and inspire others along the journey. You carry a constructive approach, can\-do attitude, a sense of humor, and authentic kindness wherever you go.
### **The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following experience, skills and competencies:**

* Demonstrated ability to set priorities and resolve routine business problems in a customer service setting.
* Excellent demonstrated written and oral communication skills and the proven ability to work effectively in both small teams and large working groups.
* Ability to work effectively with public, Sierra Club staff, vendors and consultants.
* Demonstrated ability to provide guidance to staff and to work in a team setting.
**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range for this position is $65,000 \- $70,000 annually.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Regional Operations Coordinator – Commercial Foodservice

**Company:** Plaztigo

**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area / Northern California (Field Sales)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time W\-2 (Exempt Regional Operations Coordinator)

**Compensation:** 100% Top\-Line Commission (Uncapped) \+ IRS Standard Mileage Reimbursement

**Estimated Year 1 Earnings:** $75,000 – $150,000\+ (Based on deal volume \& portfolio growth)

**Benefits:** Health/Medical Insurance NOT Included

**About Plaztigo**

Plaztigo is a modern commercial supply and distribution platform offering **700\+ SKUs**—everything a restaurant, commercial kitchen, bakery, or venue needs under one roof. Beyond our broad product catalog, we feature **custom manufacturing capabilities** for custom\-printed packaging, chopstick sleeves, and tailored branding solutions for commercial operators.

Backed by local Hayward warehouse inventory, custom printing, and a native mobile app/e\-commerce site for frictionless re\-ordering, we give foodservice businesses every reason to partner with us for years.

**The Opportunity**

As a **Regional Operations Coordinator**, you will drive field growth across Northern California by opening new commercial accounts, introducing operators to our custom branding and distribution depth, and onboarding clients onto our digital ordering portal.

**100% Full Compensation \& Earnings Transparency**

This is an **Exempt W\-2 Regional Operations Coordinator position operating on 100% Top\-Line Commission**. There is **no base salary**, but you receive direct payouts on every collected invoice dollar, fully backed by standard legal expense reimbursements.

* **Upfront Digital Onboarding Bonus:** **3\.5% on total top\-line invoice revenue** for the first paid order when you close and onboard a client onto our web/app portal.
* **12\-Month Recurring Residuals:** **2\.5% monthly residual** on all recurring re\-orders placed during the account’s first 12 months.
* **Full Expense Reimbursement:** Paid at the standard **IRS Business Mileage Rate** for all field travel between client sites (covering fuel, wear\-and\-tear, and vehicle operation).
* **Sample \& Sales Backing:** 100% company\-funded physical product sample kits, custom\-print proofs, and digital collateral.
* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance are not provided for this role.

**Uncapped Account Earnings: Real Examples**

There is **no ceiling on account size or payout**. Closing larger accounts directly multiplies your recurring monthly checks:

* **Typical Retailer ($4,000/mo volume):** Pays **$140 upfront** \+ **$100/mo** recurring residual ($1,200/yr).
* **5\-Location Local Chain ($25,000/mo volume):** Pays **$875 upfront** \+ **$625/mo** recurring residual ($7,500/yr).
* **Regional Group / Sub\-Distributor ($100,000/mo volume):** Pays **$3,500 upfront** \+ **$2,500/mo** recurring residual ($30,000/yr) from a **single account**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Field Prospecting:** Conduct face\-to\-face sales calls with restaurant owners, multi\-unit operators, commercial kitchens, and venue buyers across Northern California.
* **Digital Onboarding:** Guide clients through setup on our mobile app or web portal for automated re\-ordering.
* **Account Portfolio Management:** Monitor re\-order patterns ($3k–$5k\+/mo target volume per retail account) and follow up proactively to maintain monthly residual income.
* **Active Field Presence:** Spend more than 50% of working time active in the field meeting with buyers.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **2\+ Years B2B Sales Experience:** Proven track record in commercial packaging, foodservice distribution, beverage/food supply, or jan/san supplies.
* **Active Operator Network:** Pre\-existing, active relationships with Bay Area restaurant owners, hospitality groups, or commercial food buyers is required.
* **Self\-Driven Portfolio Builder:** Motivated by building a long\-term, high\-earning recurring commission portfolio.
* **Field Mobility:** Valid CA driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and active auto insurance.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
