jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Alex**
--------------


Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.


Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.


We're past 1M\+ interviews, integrate with 33\+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue\-generating, well\-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

**About the Role**
------------------


Every Alex account is run by a pair. A Forward\-Deployed Engineer owns the technical deployment — the ATS integration, the workflows, the support queue. You own the relationship and the revenue. You're joining the AM team early, and your input will shape the function. This role is based in office in San Francisco.


You'll carry a book of accounts: retaining and growing revenue, deepening the relationship, and finding the strategic expansion paths.

* **Own NRR for your book** — renewals end to end, plus the upsells and expansions that grow an account past its initial booking.
* **Multi\-thread the relationship** — exec sponsors, champions, and the recruiters using Alex daily, so a single departure doesn't take the account with it.
* **Drive adoption** — onboard users, run trainings, and watch usage closely enough to spot which teams need a nudge before it surfaces in a renewal.
* **Build the business case, inside and out** — arm your champion to sell Alex to their own leadership, then turn those wins into case studies that help close the next deal.
* **Lead QBRs with business stakeholders**, using usage data and our roadmap to open expansion paths. Set success criteria at kickoff so renewals confirm next steps rather than force them.
* **Work the pair with engineering** — route technical asks to your FDE rather than absorbing them, and pass expansion signals back the other way.

**About You**
-------------

* 5\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success with a revenue number, or an AE carrying a renewal and expansion book, at a SaaS company. You can name the target you carried and how you hit it.
* You've owned renewals end to end — timeline, pricing, negotiation, close — and you're comfortable asking for money.
* You've gotten a customer's team to change how they work, not just gotten a contract signed.
* Credible with executives and with recruiters on the same day.
* Technically fluent, not technically hands\-on: you can hold a real conversation about an ATS integration and know when to bring in your FDE.
* A data\-driven storyteller: you act on usage metrics before a renewal is at risk, and turn a customer win into collateral that helps win the next one.
* A commercially confident builder: you'd rather have the pricing conversation early than let it sit, and you’re excited to build playbooks for this function at you go.
* Bonus: experience at a high\-growth startup.


This might not be the role for you if you prefer a support role without a number attached, or you don't want to work in person. We're in office in SF 5 days a week.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

* Shape the foundation of our Account Management org, with an engineer paired with you on every account you run.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and growth potential.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, company\-paid team lunches, a beautiful office in SF, and great company events.


If you've gotten this far and our culture resonates with you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands\-on management support necessary for long\-term success.

  

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a **2026 Forbes Dream Employer**, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a **2026 Training MVP**by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the **Inc. 5000** list of America’s fastest\-growing private companies.

  

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

 ***HIRING IMMEDIATELY***

  

Sunstates Security is hiring an experienced **Security Account Manager** for a client site in **Santa Clara, CA. T**his position offers a an annualsalary of **$70,000/paid weekly.** The Account Manager is responsible for the daily functioning of client site locations including operations, customer service, personnel management, security \& safety in accordance with Sunstates and client objectives. Shall be available to support the services and any related issues arising from the service agreement.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Management/Leadership:**

* Responsible for the direction, coordination, and management of all site Security Personnel.
* Identify and recruit new talent with the assistance of the HR department.
* Process new employees through the Sunstates Security onboarding system.
* Train, develop, motivate and empower Security Officers to oversee all day\-to\-day operations of the site and promote the highest standards of efficiency, profitability, customer service and ethics.
* Train subordinates on procedural guidelines, company policies, and operational \& site specific forms.
* Active participation in the employee on\-boarding process including new hire interviewing and selection of candidates that meet Sunstates required level of qualifications and skills, ensure hires receive appropriate training and licensure within the designated time\-frame.
* Manage employee performance for the sites including appraising performance; administering reward and incentive programs; coaching and staff development initiatives; corrective actions with branch management guidance. In all employment activities; will work with the appropriate supervisor to ensure that all decisions comply with company policy, federal and state regulations.
* Promote positive employee relations through meeting and developing a rapport with all internal \& external customers, addressing complaints and resolving issues with regional management guidance.
* Act as the primary contact for the designated client sites and communication with the local office when appropriate.
* Maintain records with the officers assigned to assure full participation with the Sunstates Security LMS and training platform when applicable.

**Operations:**

* Coordinate with Region to establish site's goals \& objectives and communicate these with the clients as required.
* Work with action plans towards goal achievement, including establishment of sites and personnel expectations and/or goals.
* Manage administrative and operational functions to ensure the working schedule is accurate, projected working schedule is posted, vacation or time off requests are within company guidelines, the branch receives the scheduled weekly hours, and personnel topics are addressed with management guidance.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.title: Client Insights & Market Research Associate Consultant
jobs.description:
:
**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client\-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.

  


 :
**Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant** **ZS's** **Strategy Insights and Planning** teams partner with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem\-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership. **What** **you’ll** **do*** Lead and support market research projects for a global biopharmaceutical client, helping answer key commercial and strategic business questions.
* Design and execute primary and secondary market research initiatives, synthesizing findings into actionable recommendations for clients.
* Partner directly with client stakeholders and serve as a day\-to\-day point of contact for project updates, deliverables and strategic discussions.
* Coordinate and manage project execution across global teams, including colleagues based in India and Argentina, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to timelines.
* Conduct market research analyses and leverage data to uncover insights related to customer needs, market dynamics and business opportunities.
* Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling presentations and recommendations for both client and internal leadership teams.
* Support project planning, risk management and status communications to ensure successful project delivery.
* Contribute to the development of junior team members through coaching, mentorship and collaborative problem solving.
* Demonstrate curiosity, attention to detail and a willingness to learn while developing expertise in the healthcare and life sciences industry.

 **What** **you’ll** **bring*** PhD or Master's degree with a bachelor's degree in business, economics, marketing, psychology, life sciences, social sciences or another quantitative discipline. In lieu of a PhD, candidates with 2\-5 years of relevant professional experience will be considered.
* 2\+ years of professional experience outside of academic research, ideally in market research, consulting, strategic insights, customer insights or a related business\-focused environment.
* Experience managing client relationships and presenting findings to stakeholders.  

Strong market research experience, including primary and/or secondary research methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and collaborate with global teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex findings to non\-technical audiences.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational skills and a commitment to producing high\-quality work.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Associate (College Grad 2027)
jobs.description:
**About Solace**
----------------


Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.


We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission\-driven, and growing quickly.


Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

***Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement*** ***here******.***

**About the Role**
------------------


As an Influencer Marketing Associate at Solace, you'll help the team find great creators, build strong working relationships, and keep influencer campaigns moving from outreach through launch and reporting. This is an early\-career role for a recent graduate who understands internet culture, communicates well, and is excited to learn how creator marketing works behind the scenes.


You don't need years of agency or talent\-management experience. You do need strong judgment, excellent follow\-through, and genuine curiosity about creators and the communities they build. You'll learn from experienced marketers while taking on meaningful execution work from day one.


Because Solace works in healthcare, you'll also learn how to create compelling marketing while handling patient stories, claims, disclosures, approvals, and sensitive information with care.

**This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Creator Research \& Outreach**

* Research creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, and other emerging channels based on audience fit, content quality, credibility, and campaign goals.
* Build creator shortlists and organize relevant information such as audience, content style, contact details, prior partnerships, and performance signals.
* Support creator outreach using approved messaging and keep responses, follow\-ups, and next steps organized.
* Stay close to creator culture and surface new voices, formats, trends, and conversations that may be relevant to Solace.

### **Campaign Coordination**

* Help turn campaign strategy into clear creator briefs, timelines, deliverable lists, and launch trackers.
* Coordinate scheduling, content submissions, review rounds, approvals, and go\-live dates across multiple creators.
* Maintain accurate records for contracts, usage rights, deliverables, payment status, contact history, and campaign notes.
* Perform an initial check of submitted content against the brief, required disclosures, format requirements, and approved messaging before escalating for final review.
* Flag missed deadlines, unclear deliverables, or other campaign risks early and help the team resolve them.

### **Performance \& Team Support**

* Pull basic campaign metrics and organize results so the team can see which creators, messages, and formats are performing.
* Help prepare campaign recaps and document learnings for future creator selection and briefs.
* Keep the influencer roster, campaign trackers, folders, and Notion pages clean and current.
* Coordinate with brand, creative, performance, partnerships, legal, and compliance teams when campaigns require additional review or support.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, student organizations, your own content, freelance projects, campus ambassador work, talent or entertainment experience, and side projects all count.
* You are genuinely interested in creators, social platforms, digital culture, and why certain content earns trust and attention.
* You are highly organized and can keep many small details moving without losing track of deadlines.
* You write clear, warm, professional messages and understand that every creator interaction represents the Solace brand.
* You have good judgment and know when to move something forward independently versus when to ask for help.
* You take feedback well, make changes quickly, and do not get defensive when a first draft needs work.
* You are comfortable working quickly while being thoughtful about healthcare claims, patient privacy, and sensitive stories.
* You are resourceful. If you do not know how to find a creator, organize a process, or solve a small operational problem, your instinct is to figure it out.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

* A strong point of view on social media and creators, even if your experience comes from school, internships, personal projects, or your own online presence.
* Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Airtable, creator\-management tools, or similar systems is helpful but not required.
* Any experience with creator outreach, campus ambassadors, social content, talent coordination, PR, events, or community management.
* Interest in healthcare, wellness, consumer technology, or mission\-driven storytelling.

*Applicants must be based in the United States.*

**Up for the Challenge?**

We look forward to meeting you.

**Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory:** Solace Health will **NEVER** request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

**About Trustero**


Trustero is the AI\-driven advisor for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Powered by a patented multi\-agent AI architecture and our proprietary Trust Graph, Trustero automates evidence collection, control monitoring, gap analysis, and security questionnaire response — helping security, compliance, and risk teams get and stay audit\-ready across frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, and more. Enterprise, mid\-market, and MSSPs use Trustero to turn GRC from a manual, reactive burden into a continuous, AI\-powered program. Learn more at trustero.com.

**The Role**


Trustero is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to fuel our top\-of\-funnel pipeline growth across the US and EU territories. This is a pure hunter role — you will be responsible for sourcing, mapping, and opening doors at target enterprise and mid\-market accounts. You’ll engage security, compliance, risk, and IT leaders (CISOs, Heads of GRC, VPs of Security) who are actively seeking ways to modernize and scale their GRC programs through AI.


This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role for an ambitious pipeline builder who thrives on multi\-channel cold outreach, strategic account mapping, and qualifying high\-value sales opportunities in a fast\-moving market.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and generate qualified sales meetings/opportunities through outbound multi\-channel outreach (cold email, cold calling, LinkedIn, and video touchpoints).
* Own the initial stages of the sales funnel, mapping target accounts and identifying key decision\-makers across security, compliance, risk, and IT departments.
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to evaluate fit, pain points, and buyer readiness, effectively qualifying leads before handing them off to Account Executives.
* Build a solid baseline understanding of buyers' compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, GDPR) to articulate how Trustero’s multi\-agent AI delivers ROI and continuous audit readiness.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to execute strategic account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies and targeted territory campaigns.
* Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene, tracking touchpoints, account intelligence, and opportunity handoffs in Salesforce/HubSpot.
* Represent Trustero at virtual events and industry webinars, following up rapidly on leads to convert interest into qualified meetings.
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly/quarterly targets for qualified meetings set and opportunities generated.

 **What We're Looking For**

* Proven hunter mentality: a track record of high\-volume, quality outbound prospecting and self\-sourcing meetings in B2B tech/SaaS.
* 1–3 years of outbound business development or sales development experience (SDR/BDR), ideally within cybersecurity, GRC/compliance, or enterprise software.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex enterprise org charts and comfortably initiate conversations with executive buyers (CISO, CCO, VP/Head of GRC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to deliver concise, compelling value propositions.
* Familiarity with modern sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo) and CRM platforms.
* Relentless curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and resilience in handling objections and building dynamic cold touchpoints.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (e.g., German, French) are a major plus for EU territory coverage.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience prospecting for AI\-native, cybersecurity, or SaaS compliance platforms.
* Basic understanding of GRC frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) or security workflows.
* Experience running account\-based outbound motions against Fortune 2000 or mid\-market accounts.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
All Property Tech is a growing construction and property restoration company serving residential and commercial property owners throughout the Bay Area. We specialize in helping property owners, property managers, contractors, and insurance\-related partners navigate property damage and construction projects from the initial assessment through completion.

Our services include **water damage restoration, mold remediation, fire and smoke restoration, reconstruction, remodeling, property repairs, ADU construction, tenant improvements and other property improvement services.**

We are looking for a motivated, personable, and results\-driven **Business Development Representative** to help expand our network of referral partners and generate new business throughout the Bay Area.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with the people and businesses that can refer projects to All Property Tech.

This is a **relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position**. You will spend significant time meeting with potential referral partners, visiting businesses and job sites, attending networking events, following up with existing contacts, and identifying opportunities where All Property Tech can provide value.

The ideal candidate is someone who is comfortable walking into a business, introducing themselves, building relationships, and becoming the person people think of when they need a reliable construction or restoration company.

You do not need to be a construction expert on day one. We will provide training on our services and processes. What matters most is your ability to **build relationships, communicate professionally, follow up consistently, and generate business.**

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain relationships with property managers, real estate professionals, insurance professionals, contractors, commercial property owners, HOAs, apartment communities, and other potential referral partners.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities throughout the Bay Area.
* Make in\-person visits to potential referral partners and establish All Property Tech as a trusted resource.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network.
* Follow up with existing contacts to generate repeat and referral business.
* Schedule meetings, property visits, inspections, and qualified opportunities for the appropriate All Property Tech team members.
* Educate potential partners about All Property Tech's restoration, construction, remodeling, and property repair services.
* Represent All Property Tech at networking events, trade shows, community events, and industry functions.
* Develop relationships with insurance agents, adjusters, property managers, real estate agents, contractors, and other professionals who regularly encounter property damage or construction needs.
* Identify opportunities involving water damage, mold, fire damage, reconstruction, remodeling, ADUs, and general property repairs.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, meetings, referrals, opportunities, and follow\-ups.
* Track business development activities and report results to management.
* Work closely with estimators, project managers, and management to ensure qualified opportunities are properly communicated and handed off.
* Monitor market conditions, competitors, and opportunities for growth.
* Help develop creative strategies for increasing All Property Tech's visibility and referral network.
* Maintain a professional and positive representation of the All Property Tech brand.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **personable, confident, organized, persistent, and comfortable building relationships.**

The right person doesn't need to be a pushy salesperson. Instead, they should be someone who enjoys meeting people, understands the importance of follow\-up, and can turn professional relationships into long\-term business opportunities.

Required Qualifications

* 1\+ year of experience in business development, sales, account management, customer service, construction, restoration, real estate, property management, or a related field preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable meeting new people and developing professional relationships.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Professional appearance and communication style.
* Comfortable making phone calls, sending emails, and conducting in\-person business visits.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to travel throughout the Bay Area as needed.
* Comfortable using email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and customer tracking systems.

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships within the construction, restoration, insurance, real estate, or property management industries.
* Previous business development or outside sales experience.
* Experience working with property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, real estate professionals, contractors, or insurance professionals.
* Knowledge of residential or commercial construction.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Experience in the restoration or construction industry is a plus.

Who You'll Build Relationships With

A major part of this position will be developing referral relationships with:

* Property Management Companies
* Property Managers
* Real Estate Agents \& Brokers
* Insurance Agents
* Insurance Adjusters
* General Contractors
* Plumbers
* HVAC Companies
* Roofing Contractors
* Apartment Communities
* HOAs
* Commercial Property Owners
* Real Estate Investors
* Facility Managers
* Other Local Businesses \& Professionals

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position is measured by the strength of your relationships and the business you generate.

Key performance indicators may include:

* New referral partners established
* Qualified leads generated
* Referral opportunities

jobs.description:
### **Our Story**


Since 2023, our mission has been clear: to be the north star of patient equity.


Every day, we strive to bridge the gaps in healthcare access and outcomes to ensure that every patient, regardless of background or circumstance, receives the care they deserve. As a member of our team, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working alongside passionate individuals who share your dedication to creating best\-in\-class, patient\-centric products in healthcare. Together, we're revolutionizing the way people understand their health and working with the world's top researchers to accelerate innovation.

### **About Novellia**


Novellia is the first and only company that lets anyone in the U.S. gain access to nearly a decade of their health data in under 30 seconds — 100% free. All your health records, across every doctor, in one place, always up to date.


We are the only patient\-powered real\-world data platform delivering comprehensive, patient\-authorized longitudinal health insights to accelerate biopharma innovation. Unlike traditional RWD providers who deliver fragmented institutional data, we empower patients to access 20\+ years of their health records, then transform these complete health journeys into fit\-for\-purpose datasets for evidence generation, regulatory submissions, and market access. We are growing 5x year over year, have raised close to $30M in funding, and are backed by tier\-1 investors including Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Bling Capital.


Working with the world's top researchers, we turn health insights into life\-changing action for millions of people around the world.

### **About the Role**


Most marketing teams in healthcare operate like it's 2009\. Dense white papers. Forgettable webinars. Conference booths with too many pens and not enough personality.


We're building something different.


We're looking for a Marketing Coordinator who understands scientific communications or life sciences marketing, loves the science, and has been quietly frustrated by how badly the industry communicates it. You want to take what you know about real\-world evidence, patient data, and clinical research and turn it into content that people actually want to read, watch, and share.


We are looking for someone who gets things done. You are the kind of person who has a color\-coded project tracker, who follows up without being asked, and who can hold five balls in the air without dropping any of them. You bring that operational energy to a creative team and make the whole machine run faster. You will work directly with our Head of Marketing and execute across channels including events, social, and sales collateral.

### **What You Will Do**

**Own execution.** You take tasks from brief to done. That means coordinating timelines, tracking deliverables, managing review cycles, chasing approvals, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You are the person who makes the calendar real.

**Support content production across channels.** You will assist in producing materials across events (pre/post logistics, run\-of\-show, vendor coordination), social (scheduling, community monitoring, asset coordination), and sales enablement (one\-pagers, decks, collateral updates). You know good ideas from bad and you can contribute creative thoughts.

**Translate the science into plain language.** Your background in scientific communications or life sciences marketing means you understand what we actually do. You can read a study abstract, understand what it means, and help shape how we talk about it in a way that lands outside of a journal.

**Keep the team on track.** You maintain the marketing calendar. You run status checks. You flag blockers before they become problems. You are the connective tissue between strategy and execution.

**Grow into more.** Budget management, vendor relationships, creative execution, and campaign ownership are on the path ahead. This role is designed to expand as you do.

### **What We Are Looking For**

**Experience:** 1 to 3 years in scientific communications, journalism, marketing, or communications within life sciences, healthcare, or health data. Agency or in\-house both work.

**Project management, first.** This is the non\-negotiable. You are deeply organized. You manage multiple workstreams at once. You build systems for yourself even when no one asks you to.

**Scientific fluency.** You are comfortable with clinical research, real\-world evidence, or health data concepts. You do not need a science degree. You need to have worked alongside scientists or clinicians long enough to understand the vocabulary and earn the trust.

**Creative curiosity.** You have opinions about what makes content good. You notice when something lands differently than the rest of the category. You can write a clear sentence and you care about the difference between a sharp headline and a mediocre one.

**Fast\-moving and unbothered.** Priorities shift. Timelines compress. You adapt without drama and keep moving. You ask good questions when you need clarity and make reasonable calls when you do not.

**Low ego, high output.** You take the work seriously. You do not take yourself too seriously. You find something slightly absurd about how stiff and self\-important healthcare marketing usually is, and you want to fix that.

### **Tools You Are Comfortable With (or Willing to Learn Fast)**

* Project management: Notion, Slack, etc.
* Design basics: Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite
* Google Workspace (you live in Docs, Slides, and Sheets)

### **What This Is Not**


This is not a social media manager role. You will touch social, but it is one channel among several.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**


God’s Love We Deliver, a nonsectarian organization, is the New York metropolitan area’s leading provider of life\-sustaining meals and nutrition counseling for people living with severe illnesses. Begun as an HIV/AIDS service organization, God’s Love provides for people living with more than 200 individual diagnoses. God’s Love cooks and home delivers the specific, nutritious meals a client’s severe illness and treatment so urgently require. Meals are individually tailored for each client by one of our Registered Dietitians, and all clients have access to unlimited nutrition counseling. God’s Love supports families by providing meals for the children and senior caregivers of our clients. All of our services are provided at no cost to our clients.

 **About the Role:**


The Fulfillment Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the daily workflow of the Fulfillment floor to ensure the accurate, efficient, and timely packing of client meal orders. This role prepares the packing area, coordinates inventory availability, communicates order changes and substitutions, oversees labeling and route organization, and supports volunteers and staff throughout the production process. The Fulfillment Coordinator plays a key role in maintaining quality standards, food safety, and operational efficiency while ensuring client orders are completed accurately and on schedule.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Prepare the Fulfillment floor prior to the start of each shift by ensuring all required inventory, supplies, and workstations are organized and ready for volunteers.
* Communicate daily substitutions, product updates, and packing instructions to volunteers before each packing session.
* Monitor inventory levels throughout production and replenish meal components and supplies as needed to maintain workflow.
* Receive, organize, and sort route manifest labels by delivery route, including separating Healthy Start and minced/pureed client orders.
* Ensure all Healthy Start and other specialty meal orders are completed accurately and prioritized according to production schedules.
* Provide direction and support to volunteers during packing activities, answering questions and ensuring adherence to established procedures.
* Monitor quality, accuracy, and food safety standards throughout the packing process.
* Assists in maintaining the fulfillment room in an organized manner, including any shelf stable food components, thereby creating a positive work environment for staff and volunteers.
* Cover Fulfillment floor operations as needed during volunteer shift transitions or staff absences.
 **About You:**

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in warehouse, fulfillment, food production, logistics, or related operations.
* Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues quickly.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong leadership skills and collaboration skills, including coordinating teams, partnering across departments, and training and motivating volunteers.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to coordinate workflow while maintaining production schedules.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to frequently lift and move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to bend, reach, push, pull, and carry materials throughout the facility.
* Ability to work in refrigerated production and warehouse environments as needed.
* Demonstrated agility in working in a fast\-paced food production and fulfillment environment, including frequent interactions with staff, volunteers, and multiple operational departments.
**Preferred:**

* Associates degree.
* Experience coordinating volunteers or production teams.
* Knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices.

For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Supply \& Administrative Coordinator.

Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution.


Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on\-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation.


Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  



**What We Need:**


At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. You’ll play a vital role in helping our sales teams deliver on our mission to super\-serve our clients and listeners. You’ll be the operational backbone that ensures our sales process runs smoothly, efficiently, and with heart.  



**What You'll Do:**

* Support Account Executives in the pre\-sale and post\-sale process, including proposal development, order entry, campaign tracking, and reporting.
* Coordinate with internal departments (traffic, production, digital, promotions) to ensure flawless execution of campaigns across radio, digital, podcast, social, and event platforms.
* Prepare sales materials such as presentations, recaps, and client\-facing documents using tools like PowerPoint, Salesforce, and internal systems.
* Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals.
* Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded.
* Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication.
* Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing.
  



**What You'll Need:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional client service.
  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate
* Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures
* Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved
* Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts

 **Compensation:**

  

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job\-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

  

$19\.78 \- $24\.73

  



**Location:**


New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019

Regular

Full time

Hourly

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

* Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
* Company provided and supplemental life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick time
* Paid company holidays
* A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

jobs.title: Communications & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

JUNGLE Communications, Inc. is a full\-service, boutique marketing and advertising agency based in Jersey City committed to growing purpose\-driven brands.


We provide lean and results\-driven advertising, marketing, video production and brand growth solutions for our client portfolio of professional service providers (doctors, lawyers, dentists, financial institutions, educational clients, etc.), national Christian organizations, and local not\-for\-profit groups.


Our commitment to understanding our clients’ passions, experiences, and business models, along with our guerrilla marketing DNA, drive the competitive strategies we establish to help them exceed their dreams and goals.


Our search for talent is simple \- recruit awesome people who do great work and give them the ability to learn, lead and grow in our creative and caring environment.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Communications \& Marketing Coordinator who is a strong writer, naturally curious, organized, and excited to get involved in different areas of marketing.


In this role, you’ll work closely with our CEO and marketing team to support client projects, campaigns, research, content, advertising, events, and agency initiatives.


This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a well\-rounded marketing skill set rather than specialize in just one area.

**What You'll Do**

**Your day\-to\-day may include:**

* Researching clients, industries, audiences, competitors, and market trends
* Helping develop marketing and advertising campaigns
* Writing and editing copy for websites, social media, blogs, emails, advertisements, and other materials
* Supporting digital and traditional advertising campaigns
* Monitoring campaign performance and helping track results
* Assisting with social media and digital marketing initiatives
* Supporting client events, agency events, and marketing activations
* Assisting with video and creative production
* Helping develop presentations, proposals, and marketing materials
* Communicating with clients, vendors, media outlets, and partners
* Staying up to date on marketing, media, technology, and industry trends
* Contributing ideas and helping the team find creative solutions for clients

 **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For**

*You don't need to check every box. We're looking for someone who is smart, curious, dependable, and excited to learn.*

**You may be a great fit if you:**

* Enjoy writing and have strong communication skills
* Have an interest in marketing, advertising, communications, media, or creative work
* Are organized and comfortable managing multiple projects
* Pay attention to details but can also see the bigger picture
* Are comfortable researching and learning new topics quickly
* Take initiative and don't always need to be told what to do next
* Enjoy working with different types of people and personalities
* Are comfortable in a fast\-paced, creative environment
* Can turn ideas into action and aren't afraid to ask questions
* Have a positive, team\-oriented attitude

**Experience with the following is a plus, but not required:**

* Copywriting or blog writing
* Social media management
* Digital advertising/PPC
* SEO
* Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, or Google Tag Manager
* Meta Business Suite
* Canva or Adobe Creative Suite
* Public relations or media relations
* Event planning
* Video production or editing

 **Additional Information** **Education \& Experience**


A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Media, or a related field is preferred but not required.


We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. If you have the skills, curiosity, and drive to do great work, we want to hear from you.


Experience working with faith\-based, nonprofit, healthcare, professional services, or other purpose\-driven organizations is a plus—but not required.

**Salary: $48,000–$60,000 based on experience**


Vacation and holiday pay after 3 months


Some travel, evening, or weekend work may occasionally be required for client events, productions, or deadlines


A valid driver's license and reliable transportation are preferred, as occasional local travel may be required


Jungle Communications, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Warranty Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Warranty Operations Coordinator will be responsible for processing daily RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) orders at a productive rate to meet SLAs (Service Level Agreements). They will be the main point of communication for customers by answering questions and resolving problems associated with the warranty process. The team member will work closely with the shipping, logistics, customer returns, procurement, and IT departments to ensure every order is processed and fulfilled on time. The role requires problem solving skills and an ability to identify improvements to the team’s processes.


**What You Will Do**

* Process daily RMA requests to meet customer SLAs.
* Coordinate with multiple departments to solve problems and support customer requirements.
* Identify problems within the RMA order processing flow and suggest improvements.
* Use various computer programs to monitor inventory levels versus order requests and communicate low levels with team members.
* Follow up with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure all requests are resolved, using escalations when necessary.
* Be flexible to support customer requirements in a positive manner to help the team meet its SLAs.
* Identify recurring problems or delays and communicate the findings to affected parties.

**What You Bring**

* Associate’s degree (Bachelor’s degree preferred) or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years relevant experience in order processing, customer service, or warranty operations
* Basic computer skills, and the ability to anticipate risks and problems.
* The ability to master tasks and the willingness to learn new ones.
* Ownership and customer service focus.
* An ability to change priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Office products – mainly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with a high level of professionalism.
* The candidate must work well with a team of people who are committed to supporting the company’s high growth rate.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to details.

**About ZT Systems**
--------------------

Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world\-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career\-defining.


A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.  



  

Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.


**What We Offer**  

At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.


**Compensation \& Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary
* Performance\-based annual bonus eligibility
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health \& Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

\-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs\-

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Production Coordinator


**Department:** Operations


**Reports to:** Director of Production Operations


**Classification:** Full\-Time, Exempt


**Annual Salary:** $65,000 – $75,000 (commensurate with experience)


**Work Location:** Hybrid / Flexible (Flexibility for project travel and work during evenings/weekends as required by show schedules.) *\*Note: Candidates based within \~60 miles of a CAMP NYC location are preferred.*


**ABOUT THE COMPANY**



CAMP is a Family Experience Company launched in 2018, known for our one\-of\-a\-kind shop/play hybrid experience at physical locations across the country. Each CAMP store features rotating themed experiences where families come to play, explore, and create unforgettable memories together. We believe that play connects us all, and at CAMP, play is bigger, bubblier, funnier, fuzzier, slimier, and sillier than anywhere else.


**WHAT IS THE ROLE?**



We are looking for a full\-time Production Coordinator to support day\-to\-day project execution across CAMP's Production department. In this hybrid role, you will work remotely day\-to\-day while maintaining full responsibility for on\-site execution during critical project phases. You are the meticulous organizer who keeps project schedules, file systems, and vendor inventories up to date, ensuring no detail falls through the cracks—whether virtually or on the ground at load\-ins, walk\-throughs, and live activations.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO/BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**


**Support Projects \& Vendor Logistics**


* **Project Tracking:** Maintain up\-to\-date project timelines, schedules, and task management tools across active initiatives.
* **File \& Information Management:** Organize production files, assets, and project data as updates arrive.
* **Vendor Operations:** Field initial vendor outreach, conduct vetting, and coordinate ongoing communications with external partners.
* **Sourcing \& Inventory:** Source props, materials, and small\-scale vendors; source post\-launch prop replacements and maintain accurate store ordering lists.
* **Budget Support:** Track project expenditures real\-time to maintain budget accuracy, assisting with financial reconciliations upon project wrap.
* **Client \& Team Syncs:** Draft updates and support client\-facing and internal progress meetings.


**Be the Boots\-on\-the\-Ground Lead**


* **On\-Site Execution:** Serve as the primary on\-site production contact for load\-in/out, walkthroughs, launches, and live events (requires occasional evening and weekend shifts).
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Align production schedules across store teams, cross\-functional partners, and outside vendors to eliminate schedule gaps.
* **Site Quality Assurance:** Perform regular check\-ins with store and show teams to maintain setup quality and address operational needs.
* **Training \& Compliance Documentation:** Create and track execution resources, including weekly store checklists, bi\-weekly carpenter logs, and compliance guides.
* **Brand \& IP Integrity:** Ensure all physical deliverables align with CAMP brand standards and partner/licensor IP guidelines in coordination with the Director of Production.
* **Set Maintenance:** Assist with set servicing and live show maintenance planning.


**Key Performance Indicators**


* **Schedule Completeness:** Comprehensive coverage of store and show operations with zero missed details.
* **Data Currency:** Real\-time accuracy of timelines, file structures, and purchasing lists without post\-project fixes.
* **Field Satisfaction:** High responsiveness and positive feedback from store staff and on\-site teams.
* **Brand \& Compliance Accuracy:** Flawless alignment with brand/IP guidelines during site load\-in and launch.
* **Budget Precision:** Ongoing budget tracking with clean, prompt post\-project wraps.


**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO CAMP**


**Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of project or production experience within experiential marketing, events, live entertainment, or brand activations.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and multi\-tasking skills across simultaneous workflows.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing tight deadline pressures.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail across both large\-scale logistics and minor administrative tasks.
* Flexibility for project travel and work during evenings/weekends as required by show schedules.


**Experience navigating brand/IP approval workflows is a plus**


**Physical Demands \& Travel**


* Ability to travel to and work on\-site at stores or activation locations, including nights and weekends.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout store/event environments for extended periods.
* Capability to lift and carry props, materials, or equipment weighing up to 45 lbs.


**BENEFITS \& PERKS**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage (including virtual visits)
* Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Life, AD\&D, and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* 401(k) Plan (Employee Contribution)
* Flexible Paid Time Off to use for vacation, personal days, well\-being, or an illness
* Gym Reimbursement \& Commuter/Transit Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 20% Employee Discount on merchandise across all CAMP retail stores

jobs.description:
**About the Agency**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3\.7 million homes in New York City. As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team**

The Office of the Commissioner provides strategic leadership and cross\-agency coordination for HPD, advancing the agency’s mission to promote quality, affordable housing and strong, diverse neighborhoods. The team works closely with divisions across HPD, City Hall, and external partners to support decision\-making, drive priority initiatives, and ensure effective execution of agency goals.

**Your Role**

As the **Customer Service \& Administrative Coordinator (Temp)**, you will support the Commissioner’s Office by helping ensure public inquiries are routed, tracked, and addressed in a timely manner. You will serve as a key point of contact for customers reaching the office, coordinate follow\-up with operational teams, and provide day\-to\-day administrative support to help the office run efficiently. Your role will also include supporting executive scheduling and meetings, managing shared office resources, and assisting with correspondence and other administrative needs.

**Your Responsibilities**

· Determine the appropriate workflow and operational unit responsible for issues raised through webform messages, assign inquiries to the appropriate queue, and establish due dates based on the type of request and the operational unit handling the matter.

· Follow up with Operational Groups on overdue cases and reroute cases as needed. Send customers written acknowledgment within 14 calendar days of receiving their inquiry, as required under the Mayor’s Directive.

· Answer calls from members of the public contacting the Commissioner’s Office and direct their inquiries or requests to the appropriate team.

· Provide ad hoc support to the Executive Assistant, including coordinating meetings, scheduling appointments, and maintaining the calendar to help avoid conflicts, keep appointments running on time, and ensure necessary materials are prepared.

· Facilitate conference room bookings for the Executive Senior Leadership team.

· Maintain office supply inventory, place orders as needed, and distribute supplies to staff upon request.

· Sort incoming mail and facilitate follow\-up or action as needed.

**Preferred skills** 

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with members of the public and internal stakeholders.

· Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Demonstrated customer service skills and sound judgment when assessing inquiries and directing requests to the appropriate team.

· Ability to follow established procedures, track open items, and proactively follow up to support timely resolution.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel. Experience with scheduling, shared mailboxes, or case\-tracking systems is a plus.

· Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced executive office environment while handling sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and cover letter to **OperationsHR@hpd.nyc.gov** with the subject line Customer Service \& Administrative Coordinator.

**Schedule:** This is a temporary, full\-time position of approximately 35 hours per week, with a typical schedule of 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

**Pay:** $28\.00 per hour

**Work Location:** In Person, 100 Gold Street New York, NY 10038

Job Types: Full\-time, Temporary

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Flatbush Cats is a Brooklyn\-based 501(c)(3\) nonprofit working to reduce overcrowded animal shelters in New York City and prevent more cats from ending up on the street in the first place. What began as a grassroots rescue effort has grown into a citywide organization addressing the root causes through affordable veterinary care, access to spay/neuter services, and community outreach.

As an independent nonprofit—not backed by venture capital, private equity, or a corporate veterinary network—we make decisions based on our mission. We recruit team members who are passionate about expanding access to veterinary care and measure success by how many pets and families we can help, not production targets.

At the heart of our work is **Flatbush Veterinary Clinic**, a high\-volume nonprofit clinic serving low\-income pet owners, rescue organizations, and Trap\-Neuter\-Return (TNR) volunteers throughout Brooklyn. Each year, the clinic performs more than 7,500 spay/neuter surgeries—a number that continues to grow—while providing affordable wellness and dental care to thousands of pets.

By combining high\-quality veterinary care with a commitment to accessibility, we're helping keep pets with their families while creating a city where more people and pets can receive the support they need.

The Community Outreach Coordinator connects Flatbush Veterinary Clinic with residents, community\-based organizations, and neighborhood leaders. This individual\-contributor role coordinates the pet food pantry, supports trusted referral networks and partnership agreements, and operates offsite outreach events. The primary goal is to expand awareness of affordable veterinary services, remove barriers to care, help pet owners schedule and complete clinic appointments, and ensure outreach activities are consistently documented and measured.

Rolling Stone is seeking an Account Manager to join our New York\-based revenue team, reporting to the Vice President, Revenue Strategy \& Operations. This new role will serve as a critical link between Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Program Execution, and our advertising partners.



The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused media professional who can manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. The Account Manager will support the full lifecycle of advertising partnerships—from RFP response and media planning through campaign execution, reporting, and wrap\-up—while serving as primary day\-to\-day contact for active New York territory clients.


**Rolling Stone values in\-person collaboration and team cohesion, employees work onsite 4 days a week and 1 day remotely with a focus on maintaining a vibrant and inclusive culture.**


**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage campaign kickoffs, internal handoffs, status updates, pacing, and performance—proactively identifying risks and coordinating solutions across teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation.
