jobs.title: Pharmacy Benefits Account Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HUB INTERNATIONAL:**


HUB International Limited (“HUB”) is one of the largest global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a broad array of property, casualty, risk management, life and health, employee benefits, investment and wealth management products, and services. With over 21,000 employees in 600\+ offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry\-leading success in Mergers and Acquisitions.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU:**


At HUB we believe in investing in the future of our employees. Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment of open feedback and improvement that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization. We offer:

* Competitive salaries and benefits offerings
* Medical/dental/vision insurance and voluntary insurance options
* Health Savings Account funding
* 401k matching program
* Company paid Life and Short\-Term Disability Plans
* Supplemental Life and Long\-Term Disability Options
* Comprehensive Wellness Program
* Generous PTO Package \- Vacation, Holiday, Sick, and Personal Time Off
* Great work/life balance because that’s important for all of us!
* Focus on creating a meaningful environment through employee engagement events
* The ability to be a part of a motivated, winning team with the opportunity to learn from colleagues who are amongst the top talent in the industry!
* Growth potential \- HUB is constantly growing and so can your career!
* A rewarding career that helps local businesses in the community
* Strong community support and involvement through HUB Gives
**SUMMARY:**


The Pharmacy Benefits Account Manager (PBAM) is a new role in a rapidly growing team. PBAM role will support the HUB Pharmacy practice in the delivery of PBM strategy and data driven analysis. The PBAM will work directly with Pharmacy Consultants to support the Request for Proposal (RFP) process, create ad\-hoc reports as well as prepare drafts of client\-facing deliverables. The ideal candidate will have a well\-rounded understanding of pharmacy benefits, enjoy working in a face paced environment, and demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills.

**ROLE****RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Pharmacy data collection, validation, and preparation for analysis and deliverables.
* Use of multiple tools and access points to obtain the data, with consideration in locating *inconsistencies* in the data and information.
* Must proactively manage projects, workload, initiatives, and assignments as determined by the HUB Pharmacy Practice team.
* Work within the HUB Pharmacy Practice team to manage, track, and update core business activities for tracking \& business advancement purposes.
* Support lead pharmacy consultants on client engagements and meetings.
* Contributes directly to support of the design, implementation, and maintenance of standardized pharmacy team operations workflows \& pharmacy analytics strategies.
* Establish productive and professional relationships with all members of the HUB Pharmacy Practice.
* Some travel is required.
**CANDIDATE****REQUIREMENTS:**

* 4\-years\+ minimum work experience in prior Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) and/or pharmacy consulting experience.
* Bachelor's degree from four\-year college or university or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Intermediate knowledge of PBM Industry, stakeholders, intermediaries, and buyers.
* Experience evaluating and explaining various PBM models, pricing types and products.
* Strong understanding of PBM contracting life cycle.
* Experience managing and updating CRM tools (i.e., Salesforce, Monday.com).
* Refined verbal and written communication skills.
* Accomplished project manager who can juggle multiple priorities and adjust to dynamic environment. Six Sigma designation a plus.
* Detailed oriented and accurate in producing work deliverables, and capable of performing reasonability reviews of pharmacy reports, and general analytics content.
* Established history of working independently in remote or office environment.
* Must approach all tasks with a sense of urgency to meet deadlines assigned in a cross\-functional environment.
* Must possess advanced skills in the current Microsoft Office suite of applications, specifically – MS Outlook, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, \& MS Word
* **Outlook** – ability to manage email volume and keep calendar up to date
* **Excel** – the ability to learn basic \& advanced data lookup \& arithmetic calculative functions (VLookup, SUMIFS, \&etc.)
* **PowerPoint** – the ability to assemble content in standardized PowerPoint templates.
* **Word** – the ability to review, tracked, edit changes, and make document comparisons.
* Power Business Intelligence (BI) experience preferred
* Must have the ability and desire to be part of a collaborative team \& business environment, managing multiple priorities day\-to\-day.

*The expected salary range for this position is $80,000 to $110,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid\-time\-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.*

Required Travel:
Required Education: Bachelor's degree (4\-year degree)

**Overview**
------------


Your next great move.


If you're passionate about staying ahead of the curve in cybersecurity and thrive on helping organizations safeguard their most valuable digital assets, an Account Executive role at Palo Alto Networks could be your next great move. We're looking for individuals who are passionate about advanced security solutions and enjoy tailoring them to meet complex challenges. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to evangelize the Palo Alto Networks platform and highlight the benefits it can provide our customers, helping them secure their most critical digital assets. * Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company\-wide meetings

* Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel\-centric go\-to\-market approach for our customers
* Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white\-space territories and accounts

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.



Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.



Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role:**



Business Operations at Motive is a highly cross\-functional group that is responsible for developing our go\-to\-market strategy, improving go\-to\-market efficiency, and ensuring that we are hitting our growth targets. Our team is maniacal about and energized by the challenge of getting our hands dirty in any problem across Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success, and finding ways to help us scale more efficiently. We are a low\-ego, highly\-motivated group that collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to drive alignment and execution. Examples of major strategic initiatives Business Operations takes on are optimizing the structure of our sales force, experimenting with new sales and marketing motions, and determining how we can leverage AI to improve operations.


**What You'll Do:**


* **Develop go\-to\-market strategies** by analyzing market trends, customer segmentation, and Motive's competitive landscape. Collaborate with senior leaders to prioritize high\-growth opportunities and drive strategic execution, ensuring alignment across all go\-to\-market functions.
* **Lead cross\-functional initiatives** that connect the dots across different functions and stakeholders. You will be the driving force behind high\-impact, high\-visibility strategic initiatives that are critical to scaling our business by facilitating communication and collaboration between departments to ensure alignment and effective execution.
* **Create robust analytical models** and dashboards to provide actionable insights into go\-to\-market and product performance. You will take a hands\-on approach to proactively identify trends, opportunities, and risks, translating data into clear recommendations for optimizing commercial results\- leveraging AI throughout the process to drive scale and efficiency.
* **Champion operational efficiency** by continuously identifying and addressing process inefficiencies \- you never stop asking "can we be doing this better?" Design and implement innovative solutions to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and drive a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.


**What We're Looking For:**


* 6\+ years of relevant experience in consulting, banking, private equity, or Strategy \& Operations, combined with in\-house at a SaaS company
* Recent experience at a hypergrowth and rapidly scaling SaaS company
* Recent Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus
* Advanced communication, presentation, and organization skills
* Executive presence and comfort communicating with the C\-suite
* Exceptional spreadsheet / data management skills, SQL proficiency preferred
* Expert with Google Sheets \& Excel, with the ability to build data models
* Proficient in AI tools and comfortable leveraging AI to maximize effectiveness of daily work
* Intellectual curiosity supported by exceptional analytical skill
* Strong, demonstrated leadership capabilities
* Experience working on cross\-functional projects with various stakeholders and a demonstrated expertise in managing such projects
* Able to work in ambiguous, fast paced, environments under tight and unpredictable timelines

jobs.title: Bids & Client Services Liaison
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


At Freeman’s we believe that people are enriched and energized when they are surrounded with objects of significance and meaning. Freeman’s is one of the leading and fastest growing fine art auction houses in the U.S. Our values are evident in how we approach the marketplace, providing unmatched service, a focus on excellence, and holding the utmost respect for our clients and the items we steward. As a globally recognized brand, we conduct over 100 auctions each year for everything from contemporary paintings and fine jewelry to French furniture and rare books. With salerooms in Chicago, New York, Palm Beach, and Philadelphia, we stay locally relevant while passionately catering to our global sellers and buyers.

**Position Summary**


The Bids \& Client Services Liaison supports the coordination and execution of auctions by managing bid\-related inquiries, client registration, and verification, while working closely with internal teams on auction preparation and client service needs. This role serves as a key point of contact for clients throughout the bidding and auction process, providing timely, professional, and knowledgeable assistance. The Liaison passionately supports the Freeman’s brand through daily interactions with clients and Freeman’s team members. The ideal candidate follows the five principles of the Client Interaction Guidelines and reinforces their importance by providing timely feedback and maintaining a high standard of client service.

**This is an in\-office, five\-day\-per\-week position that requires occasional evening and weekend work for auctions, client engagements, and other Freeman’s events.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a variety of client inquiries in person, on the telephone, and via email, relating to all transactional aspects of bidding, buying, and selling property in upcoming and past sales.
* Provide day\-to\-day client service support, responding to questions and resolving issues in a timely, professional, and solutions\-oriented manner.
* Answer and manage incoming telephone calls and route inquiries to the appropriate department or team member as needed.
* Monitor and manage the Consign, Bid, Regional, and Client Services inboxes, as well as the Liaison’s assigned individual inbox, ensuring inquiries are acknowledged and addressed within established service standards.
* Manage a variety of client queries related to registration, bidding, payments, shipping, pickups, releases, consignments, and other auction\-related services.
* Assist clients with registering to bid and navigating the Freeman’s website and third\-party auction platforms.
* Enter telephone bids into the Auction Management System and assign phone bids on the day of the auction.
* Enter absentee bids into the Auction Management System.
* Monitor online bidding platforms and vet bidders for registration daily; communicate with bidders regarding approval, denial, or additional verification requirements.
* Respond to inquiries and resolve issues during live, online, and timed sales, providing timely support to bidders and clients.
* As designated Bid Coordinator, create and manage auction\-day schedules, ensuring all activities are organized and run smoothly.
* Assist with auction\-day operations, including phone bidding, online bidding, clerking support, registration, and other duties as assigned.
* Manage and process post\-sale offers and communicate offers to Department Coordinators on behalf of clients.
* Assist in contacting underbidders and address bidding errors or other auction\-related issues as needed.
* Assist departments with in\-person client pickups, property releases, and other client\-facing needs, ensuring a professional and positive client experience.
* Provide day\-to\-day support to clients and Freeman’s team members through in\-person interactions and other client\-facing activities as needed.
* Proactively address client concerns and take ownership of resolving issues or coordinating with the appropriate department to reach a solution.
* Assist with regional auctions and may be required to work between both Freeman’s locations (Chicago) to support auction\-day operations and client service needs.
* Complete training on all assigned auction and client service duties and assist with training new hires.
* Duties are to be performed in full compliance with department standards, including teamwork, a high level of client service, accuracy, attendance, and punctuality.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Arts Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 1\-3 years of relevant work experience.

**Essential Skills**

* Exceptional organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong client service orientation with professionalism and discretion.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent follow\-up, multitasking, and time management abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (e.g., Word and Excel).
* Able to thrive in fast\-paced environments, work under pressure, and meet strict deadlines.
* Highly motivated and eager to contribute to a dynamic team.

**Physical Requirements**

* Perform light physical tasks, including lifting and moving items such as boxes, files, and other materials up to 20 pounds, unless otherwise specified.
* Operate standard office equipment proficiently, including phones, computers, copiers, and other commonly used devices or software applications.
* Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, with internal teams and external contacts; sufficient hearing is required for routine interactions.
* Understand and accurately process written materials and documentation.
* Work efficiently in a traditional office environment, including extended periods of sitting, with the flexibility to adapt to various work settings as needed.

*Freeman’s is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Essentra Components is a global market leader in plastic injection molded, vinyl dip molded and metal components. We have a history of over 65 years, producing essential components across a huge range of industries and applications. Making it easier for our customers is our top priority. That's why we operate internationally in 29 countries across 4 continents. With every order, we offer a hassle\-free experience through our 14 manufacturing facilities, 34 distribution centres and 40 sales and service locations.  

We have over 45,000 standard parts and one of the world’s most extensive product offerings, all available for immediate dispatch and fast delivery. Our product range features caps and plugs, wire and cable management, flange protection, knobs, handles and grips, access hardware, PCB and electronics hardware.
Our Vision is to be “The world’s leading responsible hassle\-free supplier of essential industrial components”. **Job Description**  

Essentra is currently hiring an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) who will focus on day\-to\-day development and execution of the inside sales strategy at Essentra Components to drive revenue and sales growth. This individual will act as the liaison between the company and the customer, responsible for creating long\-term, trusting relationships, develop existing business, and actively seeking new sales opportunities. The Inside Sales Representative will utilize customer, product, and industry specific knowledge to engage and grow the customer base. This is a **hybrid position** that will work in our **Schaumburg** office (3 days in the office, 2 days from home). **Typical Accountabilities:*** Develop new business with existing customers and/or qualify new opportunities.
* Coordinate with the Manager to manage large projects and multi\-step opportunities through CRM Pipeline Report.
* Collaborate with purchasing departments, managers, and other staff to confirm that orders are processed with accuracy and efficiency and that products are distributed properly.
* Periodically prepare and report results, status of accounts, and leads to manager.
* Apply knowledge of the field and product features to match products to the needs of clients.
* Answer inquiries from clients concerning products, their uses, and the industry at large.
* Provide product information, quotes, credit terms, and other bid specifications to clients.
* Ensure orders, samples are entered and shipped accurately and on\-time.
* Responsible for quoting catalog items as well as simple non\-stock items.
* Report weekly updates within territory in regard to new opportunities, wins or losses.
* Maintain customer database by entering new accounts, maintaining existing accounts and consistently adding relevant notes.
* Ensure that the Essentra Components service proposition is being executed on a daily basis.
* Acquire and maintain product knowledge and market trends.
* Participate in weekly meetings as well as cross functional management meetings.
* Perform other related job duties as assigned.

 **Qualifications:*** At least 2 years of related work experience in a sales or customer service\-oriented role.
* A college degree in business, marketing or related field is a plus but not required.
* Experience working for an industrial products company is preferred but not required.
* Must be motivated, persuasive and dedicated.
* Willingness to be managed by KPI's and work toward specific daily/weekly/monthly goals.
* Must be able to identify and assess customers’ needs to exceed their expectations.
* Willingness to work in the office 3 days a week.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Works effectively with others by openly sharing ideas, identify with common goals, encourage communication and avoid conflict
* Delivers expected results by acting in a focused way and reacting positively to frustration. Be willing to adapt to changes and different circumstances
* Continuously seeks ways to improve process and increase productivity
* Ability to multi\-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Must be patient, empathetic and be able to put oneself in the customers’ shoes
* Must be a positive thinker and team player.
* Excellent reasoning and analytical ability
* Strong personal integrity and ethics
* A hands\-on/can do attitude driven by the will to accomplish tasks
* Experience using a CRM tool to track sales activity is strongly preferred
* Proficient in MS Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
* Have the ability to manage challenging customers in a professional and diplomatic manner.
* Willing to adapt to changes and different circumstances
* Continuously seeks ways to improve process and increase productivity
* Willingness to respond within 2 hours to customer inquiries

 **What We Offer:**  

This position offers a competitive base salary, quarterly bonus incentive, full benefits package, and generous paid time off.  

The expected base salary for this position is $52,000 \- $60,000\. The actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, and overall qualifications of the individual hired for this role.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for following up on leads and building pipeline for sellers across all of Motorola's North American Government Sales organization. We represent all of Motorola Solution's products and endeavor to help our customers in their quest of "Solving for Safer" by using our end\-to\-end suite of safety products.
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Development Representative is a key contributor in a rapid growth company while representing a product suite that makes an impact on people's lives. Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. Join our team and help us continue to grow!


**Responsibilities include:**

* Run call cadences (with support of an automated dialer) to educate our future customers on the value our solutions bring and drive interest in an initial conversation.
* Ask smart, targeted questions to build rapport with our prospects and identify opportunities.
* Focus on targeted outbound list.
* Collaborate with seasoned sales professionals within a territory you support to find, develop and build key stakeholder interest, and crystalize the needs of the organization across multiple customer profiles and buyer groups.

* Record prospect interactions and update records within our CRM.

* Ability to articulate value propositions via phone, video, email, and other various social networking platforms.
* Detail oriented, take exceptional meeting/activity notes, and effective in task and time management.

jobs.description:
Business Development Representative – Intermodal
  
LOMBARD, IL or CHARLOTTE, NC
  
  

Odyssey Logistics moves freight globally for over 6,000 customers — and we're looking for a Business Development Representative who's hungry to build a book of business in intermodal and get paid for every win. In this role you're on the phone, in the inbox, and out on LinkedIn, hunting cold accounts and turning them into qualified meetings for an assigned Outside Sales Representative.
  
  

**What You Bring:**  

* 1\+ years in freight brokerage, 3PL, transportation sales, or a related intermodal/logistics role
* Working knowledge of intermodal, truckload, and/or LTL
* CRM chops (Salesforce or similar) and comfort using ZoomInfo or other sourcing tools to find the right contacts
* A hunter mentality — confidence on the phone, in email outreach, and navigating gatekeepers to reach true decision\-makers
* Ability to identify a prospect's pain point, connect it to our value proposition, and earn the next meeting


**Nice to Have:**  

* A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, or logistics
* Existing shipper or carrier relationships you can bring with you
* Knowledge of key competitors and how to position Odyssey against them


**What's In It For You:**  

* Base salary in line with your experience level
* Commission eligible — reps with strong numbers can see $80,000–$90,000 in total on\-target earnings
* A running start into a sales career, working side\-by\-side with an experienced Outside Sales Representative
* Backed by an established global logistics company with real operational muscle behind your deals — intermodal, LTL, and FTL operations plus a pricing team ready to move fast


**What You'll Actually Do:**  

* Prospect mid\-market shippers daily by phone, email, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn, building and maintaining targeted contact lists
* Navigate gatekeepers and administrative assistants to identify and reach true decision\-makers
* Run discovery calls that qualify prospect interest and secure introductory meetings for the Outside Sales Representative
* Work side\-by\-side with your Outside Sales partner and pricing team to turn set meetings into submitted bids and RFQs — then track results through to award
* Maintain accurate opportunity data, activity logs, and lead data in Salesforce.com to support performance tracking and coaching


Ready to help grow Odyssey's intermodal business and get paid what you're worth? We look forward to speaking with you!
  
  

**Compensation \& Schedule Details:**  

**Base Pay Range:** $50,000 to $70,000 \[annual]

The Business Development Representative – Data Centers is responsible for driving client relationships and sales for ISEC scopes of work in mission critical and data center environments, including architectural woodwork, doors, frames and hardware, specialties, and related interior scopes, supporting projects within hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data center markets.
  
  

This role may be based in Dallas–Fort Worth, the DMV area, or Chicago.

* Responsible for achieving national sales and revenue goals and objectives.
* Drive current and new client relationships and sales for ISEC scopes of work within mission critical and data center environments, including many interior and exterior scopes.
* Delivers outstanding customer service which includes responding effectively to customer requests, resolving issues, and meeting all commitments in a timely manner.
* Utilizes market data, trends and forecasting to qualify project leads.
* Prepare and deliver formal Sales presentations to clients.
* Facilitate bid proposal and document controls throughout the sales life cycle and provide proper turnover to estimating and operations.
* Develop an overall sales strategy by assessing project risks, logistics, contract documents, vendors, subcontractors and competitors.
* Proven track record of executing all steps to develop and close large contracts.
* Develop and communicate strategies utilizing internal teams to minimize risk and maximize profit and closure opportunities.
* Prepare and finalize bid proposals to clients.
* Negotiate on ISEC’s behalf for the best possible contract terms.
* Provide pre\-construction architectural assistance and budget support to clients.
* Perform all necessary project follow\-up, status tracking, closure and price recaps.
* Ability to travel as necessary.

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Knowledge/Skills
  
* Extensive knowledge of ISEC product lines

* High School Diploma or equivalent and at least 3–5 years of experience meeting or exceeding sales goals in construction

Our dedicated professionals are the key to our success. Under the general supervision of the Logistics Manager, the Logistics Coordinator will be responsible for providing high\-level clerical and administrative support to the Logistics Department. new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet \& Rooter Services** is seeking a **Key Account Manager** to join our team! The Key Account Manager (KAM) will be responsible for protecting, strengthening, and growing LA Hydro\-Jet's (LAH) most important customer relationships.

  

**What Sets L.A. Hydro\-Jet Apart:**


* **Competitive Pay:** **$80,000\-$100,000 \+****, plus incentive program**
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan \+ match
* **Time Off:** Vacation and paid holidays

**Position Summary**

This person will serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of key accounts, developing strong connections with decision\-makers, understanding each customer's business and service needs, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand LAH's share of their business across multiple service lines. The KAM will accomplish this through regular customer contact, account planning, quarterly or semiannual business reviews, site visits, relationship\-building activities, and close coordination with LAH's operations, sales, estimating, and service teams to ensure the customer receives consistent value and strong support. Success will be measured primarily by year\-over\-year revenue growth within assigned accounts, customer retention, increased penetration of LAH services, and the strength of the overall customer relationship. The KAM will be expected to understand where each account stands financially, identify why an account is growing or declining, maintain a pipeline of expansion opportunities, and take action when business is at risk. Ultimately, the role is successful when key customers view LA Hydro\-Jet as a trusted partner and increasingly choose LAH as their primary—or preferred—service provider.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO\-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**
* 3\-5\+ years of B2B account management, strategic customer success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing a book of business, large customer relationships, or multi\-location accounts.
* Track record of retaining and growing existing customer revenue.
* Strong consultative selling, cross\-selling, negotiation, and opportunity\-development skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to customer leadership.
* Ability to analyze account revenue, service mix, trends, and opportunities using CRM and basic reporting tools.
* Strong organizational skills with disciplined follow\-up and calendar management.
* Valid driver's license, a clean MVR, and ability to travel locally throughout LA Hydro\-Jet's service territory.
* Availability for occasional early\-morning, evening, weekend, customer, or industry events as business needs require.
**What Sets You Apart:**
* Experience in property management, facilities, commercial services, plumbing, HVAC, restoration, waste, construction, or another B2B field\-service industry.
* Experience with property\-management companies, facility teams, restaurants/hospitality groups, multifamily operators, or other multi\-site customers.
* Experience conducting quarterly business reviews (QBRs), account\-planning meetings, or executive customer presentations.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable CRM/field\-service platform.
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required in place of strong relevant experience.

### **Role Expectations \& Work Environment**


* This position is expected to spend meaningful time with customers and in the field rather than working exclusively from a desk.
* The role may involve customer\-site visits, office meetings, business meals, industry events, and approved entertainment activities.
* The employee must maintain professional judgment regarding gifts, entertainment, confidentiality, customer policies, and conflicts of interest.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
* Act as the primary relationship owner when an assigned customer has a complaint, service failure, or escalation.
* Coordinate with Operations and department leadership to understand root cause, corrective action, and customer communication.
* Stay engaged until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved appropriately.
* Escalate material retention risks or competitive threats promptly to leadership.

### **Required Job Traits**



**Trait**

  

**Why It Matters**

  

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**

  


**Relationship Builder**

  


Creates trust and loyalty with customers.

  


Develops genuine relationships at multiple levels of the account.

  


**Proactive / Self\-Starter**

  


The role cannot depend on inbound calls.

  


Creates reasons to contact customers and advances opportunities without being prompted.

  


**Commercial Mindset**

  


Customer satisfaction alone is not enough.

  


Comfortably asks for additional work and seeks a larger share of customer spend.

  


**Ownership Mentality**

  


Major accounts require clear accountability.

  


Treats account performance as personal responsibility and acts quickly when revenue or satisfaction declines.

  


**Emotional Intelligence**

  


Strategic accounts involve different personalities and pressures.

  


Reads the room, adapts communication, and handles difficult conversations professionally.

  


**Curiosity / Consultative Thinking**

  


Growth comes from understanding customer operations.

  


Asks strong questions about properties, budgets, pain points, vendor structure, and future plans.

  


**Organization / Follow\-Through**

  


Large portfolios create many commitments and touchpoints.

  


Maintains disciplined follow\-up, CRM hygiene, review cadence, and next steps.

  


**Resilience / Persistence**

  


Sales and relationship\-building include rejection and delay.

  


Follows up appropriately withou

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative - Ambulatory Surgery Center
new_jobs.description:
**Territory: Southern California**

Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. With our trusted regulatory experience, insights, and infrastructure, we help manufacture and source medical products that meet the demand for value\-driven, comprehensive healthcare solutions.


**Job Summary**


The **Territory Sales Representative \- Surgery Centers (ASC)** is responsible for securing and maintaining distribution channel as well as growing Cardinal Health Brand and Preferred National Brand products within free\-standing Ambulatory Surgery Centers. The complexity of the solutions, products, and services offered is varied and can range from simple to moderately complex selling and longer sales cycle. The role reports into the Region Director, ASC and it is important that they can build and maintain relationships with key decision makers and potential influencers. Focus areas will include driving new business as well as increasing penetration in existing accounts.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage successful key relationships within ASC customers to achieve sales goals in assigned territory.
* Responsible for cold calling, prospecting and building relationships that will increase account penetration, revenue growth and customer satisfaction within ASC.
* Collaborates both internally and externally within various business units such as key contacts within national accounts, GPO Reps, and other vendors to archive results.
* Conducts data analytics and analyzes the market penetration on products both in new and existing clients. Responsible for identifying areas for development.
* Coordinates pre\-call planning with sales support staff and delegates data collection to potential other team members.
* Determines prices offered to the client based on client Group Purchasing Agreements, finding suitable and more affordable alternatives if necessary and also determines rebate eligibility.
* Complete all administrative tasks \& training including expense reports, pipeline, maintain accurate SFDC records, market feedback, etc.
* In\-service accounts by demonstrating product applications, functionality and use \- on rare occasions may include the start of a night and weekend shifts
* Attend and participate in sales meetings, training programs, conventions, and trade shows as directed. Attend all regional, divisional and sector events including National Sales Meetings and Region Meetings
* Maintain required sales activity level \- examples include the number of expected visits \& calls, number of products presented/account, etc.
* Assists distribution order support and coordination as needed. Assist customers with back\-orders and other related service issues
* Maintain knowledge of the current industry/competitive landscape including, GPO's, healthcare economics, reimbursement, competitors, competitive products, etc.
* Travel within assigned territory to call on accounts including overnight travel. Maintain active, in\-person presence at top accounts

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience preferred
* Experience in sales, account/relationship management, or customer success preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills including active listening, experience in developing and delivering presentations to both small and large groups
* Self\-motivated and proactive with a strong work ethic and a willingness to take initiative
* A critical thinker with a problem\-solving attitude, consistently seeking opportunities to improve processes and resolve issues efficiently
* Possesses a resilient and confident attitude, with the ability to overcome obstacles and maintain a positive outlook
* Technology proficiency with CRM software such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite
* A valid driver's license issued in one of the 50 States with a clean driving record
* Ability to travel up to 50% within territory including overnight stays
* Customer/Vendor credentialing may be required (this may include vaccinations). More details will be provided if you are selected for an interview

**Anticipated pay range:** $123,000 \- $125,000 (includes targeted variable pay)


**Bonus eligible:** Yes


**Benefits:** Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well\-being.


* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Paid time off plan
* Health savings account (HSA)
* 401k savings plan
* Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
* Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
* Short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* Work\-Life resources
* Paid parental leave
* Healthy lifestyle programs

**Application window anticipated to close:** 09/21/2026 \*if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.


The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

  

Los Angeles Metro Area

*Candidates who are back\-to\-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.*


*Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. Orange, California  

  

**Work Shift**

Day – 08hrs (United States of America)
**Why CHOC?**

At CHOC, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at CHOC can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. CHOC’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. **Environmental Sustainability Statement**

Driven by the connection between children's health and a healthy environment, we commit to creating a healthcare model that incorporates environmental sustainability aligned with our mission to protect children's health and patient safety.


**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator Supervisor (CRC\-Su) functions independently and is responsible for the complete coordination of multiple assigned human subjects’ (clinical) research projects and is expected to perform all core Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) responsibilities. The Supervisor serves as a mentor, an educator, and a leader with first\-line supervisory oversight (e.g., involved with hiring, reviewing, and terminating other associates). Study management includes but is not limited to assessing feasibility of clinical research protocols, preparing materials needed for regulatory review and submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), identifying potential study participants, coordinating and collecting research data/specimens, completing study records in an accurate and timely manner, participating in quality assurance audits, managing study materials and supplies, communicating across multiple teams, and archiving records in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures. The Supervisor will be responsible for financial components of clinical research projects, documentation of investigator product (drug or device), development of source documents and/or case report forms and running research/project team meetings. In this role, the Supervisor may support investigator\-initiated Investigational New Drug (IND) or Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) applications, monitor or audit studies in the Research Institute, educate and mentor clinical staff, research team members, and other coordinators, and may be requested to coordinate multi\-center studies. The Supervisor is responsible for evaluating CRC performance and assists the Site Manager in resolving operations workload, protocol implementation, and data collection issues. The Supervisor may also participate in one or more workgroups or committees within the Research Institute with a focus on CRC operations. The Supervisor is the most senior position in the Clinical Research Coordinator series.
**Pay Range**

Minimum $90,563 Midpoint $120,016 Maximum $149,427
*Rate of pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, education, as well as position requirements.*

**Experience**

Required: Minimum six (6\) years of clinical research coordination experience.


Preferred: Clinical research experience in a hospital setting and/or pediatric clinical research experience and demonstrated leadership experience.  



  

**Education**

Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent additional experience can be accepted in lieu of education.


Preferred: Master’s degree in a relevant field.


**Specialized Skills**

Required: Working knowledge of key Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills. Able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Be detail oriented. Able to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple competing priorities. Working knowledge of human subjects’ regulatory requirements and International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use Guidelines for Good Clinical Practice (ICH\-GCP). Ability to conduct informed consent. Strong knowledge of research sample identification, processing, and storage. Ability to manage conflict and to create a culture of accountability within their assigned team. Demonstrate good time and priority management and is capable of problem\-solving.


Preferred: Working knowledge of Cerner or equivalent electronic medical record system.  



  

**Licensure**

Required: Basic Life Support (BLS) \- American Heart Association. If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 6 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 6 months due to extenuating circumstances. Association of Clinical Research Professionals Certified Professional (ACRP\-CP), Certified Clinical Research Professional (CCRP) or Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) \- If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 12 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 12 months due to extenuating circumstances.

* Represents the marketing team in front of franchisees, collaborating on strategy and execution of events.

* Lead the planning, logistics, and execution of marketing activities related to new restaurant openings, independently executing NROs as assigned given the volume of openings across the market.
* Lead community outreach, public relations, event materials, and promotional assets for new restaurant openings.

* Support the collection, organization, and reporting of field marketing data, campaign performance, and local insights.
* Assist in analyzing promotional outcomes and identifying opportunities to improve future activations.

* Provide general marketing support as assigned by the Field Marketing Manager.

**PT Operations Associate at SMCP (Sandro \& Maje)**


**Location:** Bloomingdale's Fashion Island, Newport Beach, CA



 At SMCP, we embody the essence of Parisian elegance with our renowned brands, Sandro and Maje. With a commitment to accessible luxury, we bring high\-fashion designs and sustainability together, crafting exceptional products and memorable experiences. Operating in over 47 countries, we are financially stable and in an exciting phase of growth, led by a strong and experienced senior leadership team. Our culture thrives on engagement, inclusivity, and corporate social responsibility, ensuring that our success is built on both innovation and care for our planet. By 2030, we aim to meet ambitious sustainability goals, all while offering Parisian chic with a modern twist. Our collections reflect the dynamic interplay of casual elegance and evening sophistication, created for individuals who value both style and sustainability.



**Why SMCP:**



SMCP is more than just a fashion house—it's a forward\-thinking company where innovation and sustainability come together. As we continue to lead the accessible luxury market, we focus on growth, stability, and prioritizing internal mobility for our people. With a dedicated senior leadership team guiding us, we offer a culture that fosters creativity, engagement, and meaningful career opportunities. Our collections from Sandro and Maje blend timeless Parisian style with a contemporary edge, allowing individuals to express their unique personality through fashion. Joining SMCP means becoming part of an evolving story, where passion, creativity, and sustainability are at the forefront. Together, we will continue shaping the future of fashion with a strong foundation of growth, stability, and engagement.



To learn more about our global presence and values, visit our website at SMCP Global.



**At SMCP, We Style Happiness at Work—Join Our Fashion\-Forward Team!**



 As an Operations Associate, you will be a key player in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of all back\-of\-house operations, which are critical to delivering an exceptional customer experience on the sales floor. Your strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to solve problems proactively will help maintain operational excellence and support the overall performance of the store. By managing inventory, supporting visual merchandising efforts, and ensuring operational processes run seamlessly, you will directly contribute to the store's success and customer satisfaction. Your passion for operational efficiency and commitment to excellence will make you an integral part of the team.



**What You'll Do:**


**Administrative \& Merchandise Processing**


* Manage the check\-in and processing of incoming merchandise, ensuring accuracy and readiness for the sales floor.
* Coordinate store\-to\-store transfers, ensuring timely and precise movement of merchandise.
* Oversee markdown management by updating pricing and ensuring changes are reflected on the floor.
* Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) efficiently, maintaining clear records and compliance with vendor guidelines.


**Visual Merchandising \& Presentation**


* Assist with floor sets and moves, ensuring merchandise placement aligns with brand guidelines.
* Replenish merchandise regularly to maintain product availability and a fresh, appealing display.
* Maintain visual standards by adjusting displays and signage to reflect the brand's aesthetic.


**Asset Protection \& Inventory Management**


* Support shortage prevention strategies to minimize loss and protect store assets.
* Assist with inventory control, including cycle counts and physical inventory preparation.
* Ensure all safety protocols are followed to maintain a secure environment.


**Stockroom Organization \& Efficiency**


* Keep the stockroom organized and efficient to support smooth store operations.
* Implement best practices to optimize stockroom space and improve restocking processes.


**Sales Floor Support \& Customer Service**


* Assist with POS operations, ensuring accurate and efficient customer transactions.
* Greet and assist customers on the sales floor, enhancing their shopping experience.


 **Who You Are:**


* 1\+ years of prior sales support experience, including POS, merchandising paperwork, cycle counts, and inventory management.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to work within established timelines.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Brand\-appropriate personal presentation.
* Strong communication skills with team members and leadership.
* Flexibility with scheduling to meet business needs.
* Bilingual capabilities are a plus in key markets.
* Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, is required.


**Join a Career That Fits Your Life:**



At SMCP, we provide more than just a job—we provide a path to grow, thrive, and be part of something exceptional.



Your talent and dedication are rewarded with competitive base hourly pay, individual commission, and sales incentives. With our **50% shopping discount** and **seasonal wardrobe offering**, you'll always feel confident in the latest collections—because style starts with you. We also **provide a cell phone contribution**.



We know that balance and well\-being matter. That's why we provide a voluntary health plan, **401(k)**, and **paid time off**, including holiday pay—plus **paid parental leave** and **pet benefits**. You'll also have access to resources like our **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**, which includes personalized guidance, expert care, and mental health support through every stage of life, along with **MAVEN Family Planning**, providing additional support for family planning and wellness.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatric CHAMP Program
new_jobs.description:
The overall goal of the position is to support the developing research enterprises of the Child Health Advanced Molecular Phenotyping (CHAMP) Program, which is designed to help investigators better understand childhood disease by making high\-quality human biological samples and molecular data more accessible across UCSF.


Many serious pediatric illnesses remain difficult to explain using traditional clinical information alone. CHAMP addresses this gap by supporting the careful collection, processing, preservation, and study of biological samples from children across a wide range of diseases and clinical settings. The goal is to make it easier for researchers to connect what is happening in a child's body at the molecular and cellular level with the clinical course of illness.


CHAMP is built around two complementary goals. The first is to create a coordinated infrastructure for collecting biofluids and tissues from willing participants, especially children with severe, rare, or poorly understood diseases. Whenever possible, samples are obtained from the sites most relevant to disease and are processed using protocols designed to preserve their value for both current and future technologies.


The second goal is to pair these samples with advanced molecular profiling platforms that can generate detailed information about immune responses, gene expression, cellular states, antibodies, pathogens, and other features of disease biology. These data can then be used by investigators across UCSF to generate new hypotheses, identify disease mechanisms, and ultimately improve diagnosis and treatment for children.


CHAMP operates under IRB\-approved protocols that allow collection of human biofluids and tissues, including biopsy and post\-mortem specimens, across organ systems and age groups. The program has developed workflows for rapid processing, cryopreservation, and live cell preservation so that valuable samples can be studied with the best available technologies.


The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of two concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects
Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians

new_jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, collaborative Human Resources professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment? We are seeking an engaging Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support our Talent Management team with full\-cycle recruiting and onboarding operations! In this key role, you will work under the direction of the Talent Acquisition Manager and partner directly with Talent Acquisition Specialists, Recruiters, and hiring managers. You will manage the new hire experience from offer acceptance through initial onboarding and New Hire Orientation (NHO). Additionally, you will oversee Applicant Tracking System (ATS) operations, process requisition workflows, track recruiting expenses, and facilitate manager hiring trainings. If you are passionate about delivering top\-tier customer service, managing HR data with accuracy, and creating a seamless candidate journey, this position offers an inspiring opportunity to grow your HR career!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Candidate Onboarding \& Orientation**

* Serve as the primary liaison to new hires following offer acceptance, ensuring consistent and complete pre\-onboarding communication.
* Ensure all hiring forms and onboarding requirements are fully completed prior to the new team member's first day.
* Facilitate New Hire Orientation (NHO), including coordinating all logistics to prepare and finalize the orientation program.
* Manage e\-filing systems and oversee the creation of compliant electronic employee files.
* Cross\-train regularly on basic HR partner responsibilities to support clients as needed, including managing Day 1 Onboarding workflows (e.g., completing the Form I\-9 process and collecting required paperwork).
* Own newly opened or aged requisitions from inception through closure.
* Conduct requisition intake reviews for accuracy, manage timely approvals, consult with hiring managers, and coordinate with recruiters for job board postings.
* Serve as the primary point of contact to recruiters and participate in weekly recruiting calls to review search status, interview progress, and filled roles.
* Review and process Offer Authorization Request forms through required HR approval steps.
* Conduct compensation research, recommend rates as needed, track declined offers due to pay, and share data anomalies with the Compensation and Recruiting teams.
* Ensure all candidate applications are properly dispositioned and filled requisitions are closed in a timely manner.
* Manage and maintain the Applicant Tracking System (ATS)—ensuring data accuracy, cleanliness, and timely website postings, while recommending process enhancements.
* Perform accurate data entry into the Human Resources Information System (HRIS).
* Facilitate training sessions for hiring managers, recruiters, and interview panels to ensure consistent, legal, and fair applicant evaluation processes.
* Review and code monthly vendor invoices and maintain the central Recruiting expense tracker.
* Maintain regular communication with key internal and external stakeholders regarding search progress and priorities.
* Help plan, execute, and participate in community recruiting events.
* Document and maintain Talent Acquisition policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations.
* Participate in special HR projects and initiatives as assigned.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Experience**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Work Experience:** Minimum of two (2\) or more years of related Human Resources and/or office administration experience.

#### **Key Skills \& Abilities**

* **Language Skills:** Proficiency in English paired with bilingual fluency (verbal and written) in eithe**r Chinese or Spanish.**
* **Software Proficiency:** Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel; experience maintaining data accurately in an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* **Organizational \& Prioritization Skills:** Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and proven prioritization abilities to manage multi\-task demands in a fast\-paced setting.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, and phone communication skills with stellar customer service capabilities for every internal and external partner.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Discretion:** Strong administrative problem\-solving skills, critical thinking, initiative, and the ability to handle confidential details and ambiguity.
* **Event Logistics \& Teamwork:** Experience in event/meeting planning, participation, and facilitation, with a strong comfort level working within a collaborative team.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with recruiting expense tracking, invoice processing, or HR compliance documentation.
* Prior experience delivering or supporting manager\-level HR training modules.

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt Position (40 hours per week).
* **Work Setting:** Hybrid Model (2 days per week on\-site)
* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM.
* **Physical \& Travel Requirements:** Occasional local travel within the SF Bay Area (up to 25 lbs. lifting capability required for recruiting event setup).

**If you're interested, please reply to this advertisement or directly email your resume to me at DSalgado@teemagroup.com or by calling/texting (949\) 295\-5951\.**  

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**

new_jobs.description:
### **Our Story**


Since 2023, our mission has been clear: to be the north star of patient equity.


Every day, we strive to bridge the gaps in healthcare access and outcomes to ensure that every patient, regardless of background or circumstance, receives the care they deserve. As a member of our team, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working alongside passionate individuals who share your dedication to creating best\-in\-class, patient\-centric products in healthcare. Together, we're revolutionizing the way people understand their health and working with the world's top researchers to accelerate innovation.

### **About Novellia**


Novellia is the first and only company that lets anyone in the U.S. gain access to nearly a decade of their health data in under 30 seconds — 100% free. All your health records, across every doctor, in one place, always up to date.


We are the only patient\-powered real\-world data platform delivering comprehensive, patient\-authorized longitudinal health insights to accelerate biopharma innovation. Unlike traditional RWD providers who deliver fragmented institutional data, we empower patients to access 20\+ years of their health records, then transform these complete health journeys into fit\-for\-purpose datasets for evidence generation, regulatory submissions, and market access. We are growing 5x year over year, have raised close to $30M in funding, and are backed by tier\-1 investors including Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Bling Capital.


Working with the world's top researchers, we turn health insights into life\-changing action for millions of people around the world.

### **About the Role**


Most marketing teams in healthcare operate like it's 2009\. Dense white papers. Forgettable webinars. Conference booths with too many pens and not enough personality.


We're building something different.


We're looking for a Marketing Coordinator who understands scientific communications or life sciences marketing, loves the science, and has been quietly frustrated by how badly the industry communicates it. You want to take what you know about real\-world evidence, patient data, and clinical research and turn it into content that people actually want to read, watch, and share.


We are looking for someone who gets things done. You are the kind of person who has a color\-coded project tracker, who follows up without being asked, and who can hold five balls in the air without dropping any of them. You bring that operational energy to a creative team and make the whole machine run faster. You will work directly with our Head of Marketing and execute across channels including events, social, and sales collateral.

### **What You Will Do**

**Own execution.** You take tasks from brief to done. That means coordinating timelines, tracking deliverables, managing review cycles, chasing approvals, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You are the person who makes the calendar real.

**Support content production across channels.** You will assist in producing materials across events (pre/post logistics, run\-of\-show, vendor coordination), social (scheduling, community monitoring, asset coordination), and sales enablement (one\-pagers, decks, collateral updates). You know good ideas from bad and you can contribute creative thoughts.

**Translate the science into plain language.** Your background in scientific communications or life sciences marketing means you understand what we actually do. You can read a study abstract, understand what it means, and help shape how we talk about it in a way that lands outside of a journal.

**Keep the team on track.** You maintain the marketing calendar. You run status checks. You flag blockers before they become problems. You are the connective tissue between strategy and execution.

**Grow into more.** Budget management, vendor relationships, creative execution, and campaign ownership are on the path ahead. This role is designed to expand as you do.

### **What We Are Looking For**

**Experience:** 1 to 3 years in scientific communications, journalism, marketing, or communications within life sciences, healthcare, or health data. Agency or in\-house both work.

**Project management, first.** This is the non\-negotiable. You are deeply organized. You manage multiple workstreams at once. You build systems for yourself even when no one asks you to.

**Scientific fluency.** You are comfortable with clinical research, real\-world evidence, or health data concepts. You do not need a science degree. You need to have worked alongside scientists or clinicians long enough to understand the vocabulary and earn the trust.

**Creative curiosity.** You have opinions about what makes content good. You notice when something lands differently than the rest of the category. You can write a clear sentence and you care about the difference between a sharp headline and a mediocre one.

**Fast\-moving and unbothered.** Priorities shift. Timelines compress. You adapt without drama and keep moving. You ask good questions when you need clarity and make reasonable calls when you do not.

**Low ego, high output.** You take the work seriously. You do not take yourself too seriously. You find something slightly absurd about how stiff and self\-important healthcare marketing usually is, and you want to fix that.

### **Tools You Are Comfortable With (or Willing to Learn Fast)**

* Project management: Notion, Slack, etc.
* Design basics: Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite
* Google Workspace (you live in Docs, Slides, and Sheets)

### **What This Is Not**


This is not a social media manager role. You will touch social, but it is one channel among several.


This is not a pure writing role. You will contribute to content, but execution and coordination are the job.

The Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone that keeps Glowbar studios stocked, growing, and running smoothly. new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**


God’s Love We Deliver, a nonsectarian organization, is the New York metropolitan area’s leading provider of life\-sustaining meals and nutrition counseling for people living with severe illnesses. Begun as an HIV/AIDS service organization, God’s Love provides for people living with more than 200 individual diagnoses. God’s Love cooks and home delivers the specific, nutritious meals a client’s severe illness and treatment so urgently require. Meals are individually tailored for each client by one of our Registered Dietitians, and all clients have access to unlimited nutrition counseling. God’s Love supports families by providing meals for the children and senior caregivers of our clients. All of our services are provided at no cost to our clients.

 **About the Role:**


The Fulfillment Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the daily workflow of the Fulfillment floor to ensure the accurate, efficient, and timely packing of client meal orders. This role prepares the packing area, coordinates inventory availability, communicates order changes and substitutions, oversees labeling and route organization, and supports volunteers and staff throughout the production process. The Fulfillment Coordinator plays a key role in maintaining quality standards, food safety, and operational efficiency while ensuring client orders are completed accurately and on schedule.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Prepare the Fulfillment floor prior to the start of each shift by ensuring all required inventory, supplies, and workstations are organized and ready for volunteers.
* Communicate daily substitutions, product updates, and packing instructions to volunteers before each packing session.
* Monitor inventory levels throughout production and replenish meal components and supplies as needed to maintain workflow.
* Receive, organize, and sort route manifest labels by delivery route, including separating Healthy Start and minced/pureed client orders.
* Ensure all Healthy Start and other specialty meal orders are completed accurately and prioritized according to production schedules.
* Provide direction and support to volunteers during packing activities, answering questions and ensuring adherence to established procedures.
* Monitor quality, accuracy, and food safety standards throughout the packing process.
* Assists in maintaining the fulfillment room in an organized manner, including any shelf stable food components, thereby creating a positive work environment for staff and volunteers.
* Cover Fulfillment floor operations as needed during volunteer shift transitions or staff absences.
 **About You:**

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in warehouse, fulfillment, food production, logistics, or related operations.
* Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues quickly.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong leadership skills and collaboration skills, including coordinating teams, partnering across departments, and training and motivating volunteers.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to coordinate workflow while maintaining production schedules.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to frequently lift and move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to bend, reach, push, pull, and carry materials throughout the facility.
* Ability to work in refrigerated production and warehouse environments as needed.
* Demonstrated agility in working in a fast\-paced food production and fulfillment environment, including frequent interactions with staff, volunteers, and multiple operational departments.
**Preferred:**

* Associates degree.
* Experience coordinating volunteers or production teams.
* Knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices.

new_jobs.description:
**Join the Glowbar Team:**  



 Glowbar is reinventing the facial with custom, 30\-minute treatments led by expert estheticians, designed to deliver results. Since launching in NYC in 2019, we’ve grown fast, with locations across the Northeast and more on the way.  



 The Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone that keeps Glowbar studios stocked, growing, and running smoothly. You own inventory across the studio network — from monthly purchase orders to ecomm product ordering to HQ supply and collateral — and you get hands\-on with New Studio Openings, traveling to support procurement and on\-site setup. You're the first line of our support inbox, managing timebound responses and company service level agreements (SLA) and overseeing our offshore support partner, and you keep studios connected and equipped through systems administration, resource management, and internal communications like our weekly newsletter and intranet. If you love variety, thrive on staying organized across a dozen moving pieces, and want a front\-row seat to Glowbar's growth, this is the role for you.  



 **What You’ll Do:**  



 You keep the engine running behind the scenes so studios can focus on clients. Every week, you'll:

  

* Manage the monthly studio purchase order process, ensuring every studio is fully and accurately stocked with product and supplies
  
* Own ecommerce product ordering and fulfillment, shipping orders in a timely manner and flagging resourcing needs as volume scales
  
* Manage HQ supply and collateral ordering, keeping field teams and marketing initiatives fully equipped
  
* Manage vendor relationships to help ensure quality, cost efficiency, and on\-time delivery of products and services
  
* Manage New Studio Openings (NSO), end to end, through procurement and hands\-on setup, traveling on\-site to help execute set up to turnover
  
* Conduct weekly NSO meetings to ensure stakeholders are driving towards deadlines according to the company playbooks
  
* Partner with the NSO and Training team, Studio Development Real Estate, and Field Area Managers to coordinate deliveries, ordering, and studio setup ahead of each opening
  
* Manage the support inbox, resolving client inquiries related to memberships, bookings, and general customer experience within company required SLA
  
* Oversee and manage our remote/offshore support partner, ensuring quality, consistency, and SLA adherence in day\-to\-day client interactions
  
* Serve as systems and platform admin owner, acting as the corporate liaison for platform set\-up, troubleshooting, and new product/studio configuration across POS/Schedule platform, proprietary company platforms and across Google Marketplace
  
* Support onboarding of new hires across email, Slack, and core systems (BLVD, Prospr, Method) and vendor accounts
  
* Own studio resources and communications, including the weekly newsletter and intranet, keeping field teams informed and aligned
  
* Maintain and update operational playbooks, policies, and SOPs (Operations Manual, NSO Playbook) so field resources stay current and accurate
  

 **Who We’re Looking For:**

  

* 2\+ years of operations experience (i.e. restaurant, retail, hotel, salon/spa, or comparable) with a proven track record of superior customer service
  
* Quick study and high level of confidence working in a variety of systems and platforms
  
* Ability to manage multiple projects through prioritization and planning skills; demonstrated ability to wear multiple hats and work in a scrappy environment (ready to roll up your sleeves)
  
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through
  
* Highly motivated and results\-oriented, resourceful and creative
  
* Eager to join a fast\-growing team and collaborate closely across functions
  
* Exceptional customer\-first mindset, both internal and external
  
* Outstanding interpersonal, written, and organizational skills
  
* Comfortable managing vendor and remote/offshore partner relationships
  
* Forward\-thinking problem solver with a strong work ethic
  
* Passion for beauty, skincare, learning, and trying new things every day
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
  
* Ability to travel to support New Studio Openings (approximately 20–30% of the time, with heavier travel during opening weeks)
  

 **Your Glow Package (Compensation \& Benefits):**

  

* Annual bonus potential tied to company EBITDA performance
  
* Annual compensation increase eligibility
  
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance largely covered by Glowbar
  
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave
  
* 6 Paid holidays
  
* DailyPay \- access part of your paycheck before payday at no cost
  
* Disability, accident, critical illness, and life insurance coverage
  
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental wellness support
